x1.objectif: Prepare ankles, knees, hips and shoulders before the effort.
x1.placement: Group in a wide circle, the leader in the middle.
etapes: (3 min) Slow ankle, knee and hip rotations, one joint at a time.
(3 min) High knees and butt kicks in place, building the pace.
(2 min) Big arm circles, then shuffle around the circle.
x1.consignes: Range of motion first, speed second. The body warms up with no jerky moves.
x1.corrections: Demand a slow tempo for the first two minutes.
x1.reussite: Every player is sweating lightly and moves without stiffness.
x1.vHard: Add a ball with a low dribble during the mobility work.

x2.objectif: Improve foot speed and the response to a signal.
x2.placement: One ladder on the floor, players in a single line, coach facing the group.
etapes: (3 min) One foot per box going up, light jog back. 3 reps, stay on the balls of your feet, eyes up.
(3 min) In-and-out pattern, two feet per box. 4 reps, arms moving with the rhythm.
(2 min) Lateral shuffle along the ladder, shoulders facing it. 3 reps each side.
(2 min) Exit the ladder and sprint 3 meters on the coach's visual signal. 6 starts, full recovery between each.
x2.consignes: Short, quick steps on the balls of the feet, head up to read the signal, active arms. Quality before speed: a clean pattern beats a fast, sloppy one.
x2.erreurs: Eyes glued to the floor, stiff shoulders.
x2.corrections: Put a marker on the wall to force the eyes forward.
x2.reussite: Quick feet with no pattern mistake on two reps in a row.
x2.vHard: Left or right hand signal decides the sprint direction.

x3.objectif: Work on reading the opponent and defensive footwork without the ball.
x3.placement: In pairs, face to face, one leader and one mirror.
etapes: (3 min) The leader shuffles, the mirror copies the movement.
(3 min) Add changes of direction and sharp stops.
(2 min) Switch roles every 30 seconds.
x3.consignes: Stay low, weight on the balls of your feet, feet never cross.
x3.corrections: Remind them to sit down in a wide stance.
x3.reussite: The mirror stays square to the leader without losing balance.
x3.vHard: Add a fake start the mirror has to read.

x4.objectif: Strengthen the trunk to stabilize the shot and balance on contact.
x4.placement: Everyone on the floor, the coach runs the clock.
etapes: (3 min) Front plank, 3 sets of 20 seconds on, 20 off. Body in a straight line from heels to shoulders.
(2 min) Side plank, 2 sets of 20 seconds per side, hip up.
(3 min) Slow glute bridge, 3 sets of 10 reps: 2 seconds up, 2 hold, 2 down.
x4.consignes: Abs and glutes tight, hips locked, steady breathing, don't hold your breath. Progression: extend the hold to 30 seconds, then single-leg glute bridge once the hips stop tilting.
x4.erreurs: Hips sagging, arched back, holding the breath.
x4.corrections: Have them breathe out on every effort and keep shoulders, hips and heels in line.
x4.reussite: Position held without breaking the line for the full time.
x4.vHard: Lift one arm or one leg during the plank.

x5.objectif: Combine jumps, footwork and dribbling in one task.
x5.placement: A loop course, one line of players, one ball each.
etapes: (3 min) Two-foot jumps into the hoops, holding the ball.
(4 min) Dribble slalom through the cones, outside hand.
(3 min) Finish with a set shot from a standstill at the end of the course.
x5.consignes: Control before speed, switch hands at every cone, balanced stop to finish.
x5.erreurs: Speed at the expense of ball control.
x5.corrections: Lose the ball, go back to the previous cone.
x5.reussite: Full course with no lost ball and a stable stop.
x5.vEasy: No ball first, then holding the ball.
x5.vHard: Two balls or weak hand only.

x6.objectif: Protect the ball with a low dribble and change hands under light pressure.
x6.placement: Each player in a marked square, ball in hand.
etapes: (3 min) Low dribble with the strong hand, chest forward, off arm protecting.
(3 min) Crossover in front of the body on every signal.
(2 min) A passive defender tries to touch the ball, the dribbler protects it.
x6.consignes: Dribble below the knee, off arm out, eyes up.
x6.erreurs: Dribble too high, off hand doing nothing.
x6.corrections: Lower the dribble and get the off arm up to protect.
x6.reussite: The ball stays under control despite the defender's pressure.
x6.vHard: Active defender, or weak hand only.

x7.objectif: Make the weak hand as reliable as the strong hand by doubling the load.
x7.placement: One player, two balls, five meters of space.
etapes: (3 min) Dribble both balls at the same time, same height.
(4 min) Alternating dribble, one ball high, one ball low.
(3 min) On the move over five meters, turn around, come back without losing a ball.
x7.consignes: Stay bent, both hands push, eyes don't drop.
x7.erreurs: One side takes over, the other loses the ball.
x7.corrections: Slow down until both hands are back in sync.
x7.reussite: Twenty seconds of alternating dribble without losing a ball.
x7.vHard: One ball goes between the legs while the other keeps going.

x8.objectif: Win the defender's shoulder with a sharp change of direction.
x8.placement: One cone per player as the defender, start three meters away.
etapes: (4 min) Dribble at the cone, crossover when you reach it, accelerate.
(3 min) Same start, behind-the-back change.
(3 min) Crossover, then keep dribbling to the rim.
x8.consignes: Change speed as you change hands, shoulder goes past the cone.
x8.erreurs: Slow, predictable change, no burst after it.
x8.corrections: Demand a sharp burst right after the hand change.
x8.reussite: The player gets past the cone with a real gain in speed.
x8.vEasy: No burst, move learned in slow motion.
x8.vHard: Live, semi-active defender instead of the cone.

x9.objectif: Dribble head up while reacting to an outside cue.
x9.placement: Everyone dribbles inside a square, the coach holds up colored cones.
etapes: (3 min) Free dribble, eyes on the coach.
(3 min) Color called, hand change required.
(2 min) Two colors to remember, then execute in order.
x9.consignes: Eyes on the signal, never on the ball, dribble pushed to the side.
x9.erreurs: Eyes drop as soon as the hand changes.
x9.corrections: Slow the move down, keep reading the cue.
x9.reussite: The player gives the right response without looking down.
x9.vHard: Free movement with obstacles to avoid.

x10.objectif: Master a balanced stop after a burst of speed.
x10.placement: Start at half court, one cone at the high post.
etapes: (3 min) Three speed dribbles, then a jump stop, both feet down.
(4 min) Same stop followed by a front pivot and a reverse pivot.
(3 min) Stop, then straight into a set shot.
x10.consignes: Low, wide stop, ball protected, pivot foot set.
x10.erreurs: Off-balance stop, travel on the pivot.
x10.corrections: Slow the approach until the stop is truly stable.
x10.reussite: Clean stop with no extra step.
x10.vHard: Stop after a full-speed hand change.

x11.objectif: Bring the ball up fast while keeping control, as in transition.
x11.placement: Start on the baseline, facing the full court.
etapes: (3 min) Speed dribble to the opposite baseline, strong hand.
(3 min) Back with the weak hand, no carrying.
(2 min) Down and back with a required hand change at half court.
x11.consignes: Push the ball out in front at hip height, head up.
x11.erreurs: Ball stuck to the body, eyes down.
x11.corrections: Push the dribble out in front of you and look up at the far rim.
x11.reussite: Fast trip up the floor with no turnover or carry.
x11.vHard: Two required changes of direction per length.

x12.objectif: Repeat passing without a partner with instant feedback.
x12.placement: Facing a wall, three meters away, a target at chest height.
etapes: (2 min) Twenty two-hand chest passes at the target.
(2 min) Twenty bounce passes, bouncing two thirds of the way.
(2 min) Ten one-hand passes, right then left.
x12.consignes: Push the ball through, thumbs down, step toward the target on every pass.
x12.corrections: Move closer, then step back once you hit the target every time.
x12.reussite: Clean sequence with no ball on the floor.

x13.objectif: Pass and move at once, with no dead time.
x13.placement: Five spots in a star around the paint.
etapes: (3 min) Chest pass, then run to the spot you passed to.
(4 min) Always follow your pass to the line across from you.
(3 min) Add a second ball once the ball movement is smooth.
x13.consignes: Crisp pass in front of the receiver, sprint right after the pass.
x13.corrections: Demand a real sprint after every pass and a loud call.
x13.reussite: Two balls moving with no drop for one minute.

x14.objectif: Run, pass and finish without dribbling across the whole court.
x14.placement: Three lines on the baseline, ball in the middle.
etapes: (3 min) The ball handler passes to one side and runs behind the receiver.
(4 min) Passes keep flowing up the floor, no dribbling.
(3 min) Finish on the run at the far end, a rebounder outlets the ball.
x14.consignes: Pass in front of the runner, never at his feet, no dribbling.
x14.erreurs: Late pass, travel on the finish.
x14.corrections: A trio that makes a technical mistake runs the length again.
x14.reussite: Ten finishes in a row with no passing mistake.
x14.vEasy: Walk it through to learn the running pattern.
x14.vHard: Team target, coming back in a five-man weave.

x15.objectif: Draw a defender before serving the open player.
x15.placement: Two attackers, one defender, half court.
etapes: (4 min) The ball handler attacks the rim to draw the defender.
(4 min) As soon as the defender commits, pass to the open teammate.
(4 min) The receiver finishes as close as possible, then rotate.
x15.consignes: Eyes on the rim to draw the defender, simple pass at the right time, run your lane.
x15.erreurs: Passing too early, before drawing the defender.
x15.corrections: Demand at least one attacking dribble before the pass.
x15.reussite: The pass creates an open shot right at the rim.
x15.vHard: A second defender comes back to help.

x16.objectif: Build a clean shooting motion before talking about range.
x16.placement: One meter from the rim, square to the basket, shooting hand under the ball.
etapes: (3 min) One-hand shots right at the rim, other hand behind the back.
(3 min) Snap the wrist, fingers pointing to the floor, hold the follow-through for one second.
(2 min) Five makes in a row, then one small step back.
x16.consignes: Only move back if the form stays clean, ball with backspin.
x16.erreurs: Both hands pushing, elbow flaring out.
x16.corrections: Go back close to the rim and isolate the shooting hand.
x16.reussite: Five clean shots in a row before stepping back.
x16.vEasy: Seated on a chair to isolate the arm.
x16.vHard: Add the guide hand, then shoot off the catch.

x17.objectif: Shoot right after the catch, as in a game.
x17.placement: One passer at the top of the key, spots around the arc.
etapes: (4 min) The shooter runs to a spot, hands ready.
(4 min) Catch, then shoot on balance, no dribble.
(4 min) Work through the spots in order, count the makes.
x17.consignes: Show target hands before the ball arrives, balanced stop, follow through with the wrist.
x17.erreurs: An unnecessary dribble before the shot.
x17.corrections: No dribbling allowed on this set.
x17.reussite: Target score reached on at least one spot.
x17.vHard: A defender comes out to contest the shot.

x18.objectif: Finish on the move with the right hand and left hand off the correct foot.
x18.placement: One line on the right side, one line on the left side.
etapes: (4 min) Layup on the run from the right side, take off from the left foot, right hand.
(4 min) Same finish from the left side, take off from the right foot, left hand.
(2 min) Both sides back to back, keeping the rhythm.
x18.consignes: Ball high, take off from the foot opposite the shooting hand, eyes on the small square.
x18.erreurs: Wrong hand or wrong foot on the weak side.
x18.corrections: Slow down the weak side and fix the footwork first.
x18.reussite: Smooth makes on both sides at running speed.
x18.vEasy: From a standstill under the rim.
x18.vHard: Start with a dribble from half court.

x19.objectif: Automate alternating finishes under the rim.
x19.placement: Under the rim, slightly to the right, ball in hand.
etapes: (3 min) Right-hand finish on the right side, ball caught high.
(3 min) Grab it before it hits the floor, step to the left side, left-hand finish.
(2 min) Thirty seconds nonstop, count the makes.
x19.consignes: Ball above the shoulders, opposite foot, eyes on the small square.
x19.corrections: Keep the ball high and go straight into the next one.
x19.reussite: Beat your record of makes in thirty seconds.

x20.objectif: Avoid contact with an offset step before the finish.
x20.placement: A cone in the paint as the defender, start on the dribble.
etapes: (4 min) Come in on the dribble, pick the ball up with two hands, first step to one side.
(3 min) Second step to the other side of the cone.
(3 min) Protected finish after the side step.
x20.consignes: Clean pickup, two steps only, ball protected away from the cone.
x20.erreurs: Travel, or finishing on the same side as the first step.
x20.corrections: Count both steps out loud to lock in the rhythm.
x20.reussite: The player gets around the cone in two steps and finishes.
x20.vHard: Live, semi-active defender instead of the cone.

x21.objectif: Score over a tall defender before he steps up.
x21.placement: Start on the wing, a tall obstacle in the paint.
x21.materiel: 1 ball, a tall cone or a partner with arms up
etapes: (4 min) Two dribbles toward the paint, one-foot takeoff, ball pushed up high and soft.
(3 min) Find the angle off the glass depending on the side.
(3 min) Alternate both sides.
x21.consignes: Stable vertical jump, soft wrist, ball released before contact.
x21.erreurs: Shot too flat or too late, right at the defender's level.
x21.corrections: Release the ball earlier and higher.
x21.reussite: The shot drops into the rim over the obstacle.
x21.vEasy: No obstacle, focus on the motion.
x21.vHard: Live help defender stepping up to block.

x22.objectif: Set up a simple inside game by reading the defender's position.
x22.placement: One big with his back to the basket, one passer, one defender.
etapes: (4 min) Catch with your back to the basket, ball protected, feel the defender.
(4 min) Defender behind: drop step to the rim. Defender on one side: go the other way.
(4 min) Finish, then rotate the defender.
x22.consignes: Sit on your defender, keep the ball high and strong, read his feet.
x22.corrections: Limit to one dribble and protect the ball under the chin.
x22.reussite: The side chosen matches where the defender is.
x22.vEasy: Passive defender who calls his side.

x23.objectif: Repeat shots from several spots in a motivating game.
x23.placement: Five to seven spots around the paint, two teams.
etapes: (4 min) Shoot from a spot, make it and move to the next one.
(4 min) Miss it, wait your turn and go again from the same spot.
(4 min) First team around the whole circuit wins.
x23.consignes: Same form everywhere, balance first, distance second.
x23.corrections: Remind them the mechanics stay the same, only the leg drive goes up.

x24.objectif: Keep a stable shot as fatigue rises, as at the end of a game.
x24.placement: Five spots around the arc, one passer, one rebounder, a target score.
etapes: (4 min) Before every shot, sprint to touch the baseline, then back to the spot.
(4 min) Catch and shoot on balance, count the makes.
(4 min) The set only counts once the target score is reached.
x24.consignes: Same mechanics tired or fresh, balance before loading the shot.
x24.corrections: Lower the pace rather than the quality of the shot.
x24.reussite: Target score held despite the effort.
x24.vHard: Shot off the dribble right after the sprint.

x25.objectif: Punish a defender who overplays the passing lane with a cut behind his back.
x25.placement: A ball handler at the top, a wing guarded tight, an aggressive defender.
etapes: (4 min) The wing calls for the ball, the defender overplays in front.
(4 min) Backdoor cut to the rim, pass on time.
(4 min) Finish, then rotate roles.
x25.consignes: Read the defender's position, cut hard when his hand is in the passing lane.
x25.erreurs: Cut too early or pass too late.
x25.corrections: Sync the passer's eyes with the cutter's first step.
x25.reussite: The cut creates an easy finish at the rim.

x26.titre: Setting and reading the ball screen
x26.objectif: Set a solid legal screen, then read the ball handler's exit.
x26.placement: A ball handler, a screener, no defense to start.
etapes: (4 min) The screener arrives, feet wide, screen still and legal.
(4 min) The ball handler comes off the screen shoulder to shoulder.
(4 min) The screener follows with his move: roll or pop.
x26.consignes: Screen still on contact, angled toward the ball, sharp move by the screener.
x26.erreurs: Moving screen, ball handler going too wide around it.
x26.corrections: Have him come off the screen tight to cut off the coverage.
x26.reussite: The ball handler comes off free, the screener follows with an option.

x27.objectif: Teach the handler to read the coverage and choose the right response.
x27.placement: A ball handler and a screener against two defenders who change coverage.
etapes: (5 min) The defense calls its coverage: hedge, drop, or switch.
(5 min) The handler reads before the screen, then chooses: shot, pass to the roller, or kick-out.
(5 min) Alternate coverages to force the read.
x27.consignes: Read early, keep your dribble alive, go for the right option, not the highlight play.
x27.erreurs: Decision made before reading the defense.
x27.corrections: Have the defense call its coverage so the handler has to look.
x27.reussite: The answer matches the defensive coverage.
x27.vEasy: Passive defense that calls its coverage.
x27.vHard: Add weak-side help, move to 3 on 3.

x28.objectif: Start a fluid attack with a hand-off.
x28.placement: A passer at the high post, a perimeter player coming to get it, a finisher.
etapes: (4 min) The perimeter player cuts toward the ball handler and takes the hand-off, shoulder to shoulder.
(4 min) The passer follows with a screen, like a pick and roll.
(4 min) The receiver attacks, shoots, or hits the passer rolling to the rim.
x28.consignes: Protected hand-off, change of pace on the catch, read the defender.
x28.corrections: Shoulders tight and accelerate on the catch.
x28.reussite: The action creates a finish or an open shot.

x29.titre: Spacing and use of the floor
x29.objectif: Keep proper distances between attackers to open passing lanes.
x29.placement: Five attackers on five markers, no defense to start.
etapes: (4 min) Move the ball without dribbling, everyone holds their spot.
(4 min) On every drive, the others relocate to the open angles.
(4 min) Add a passive defense to stretch with the spacing.
x29.consignes: One pass apart between players, fill the space the ball handler leaves.
x29.erreurs: Players bunched up, passing lanes clogged.
x29.corrections: Mark the spots on the floor and make them hold them.
x29.reussite: All five attackers stay spread, every pass is open.
x29.vHard: Active defense that packs the paint.

x30.titre: Reading the help and the extra pass
x30.objectif: Punish every defensive help with one more pass to the open player.
x30.placement: Four attackers around the arc, three defenders in the paint.
etapes: (5 min) Fast ball movement, nobody holds the ball for more than two seconds.
(5 min) The defenders close out on the ball handler, the offense looks for the open player.
(5 min) Basket or turnover, three new defenders come in.
x30.consignes: The pass travels faster than the runner, attack the closeout, the extra pass makes the open shot.
x30.erreurs: Ball handler holds the ball, contested shot.
x30.corrections: Limit each player to one second on the ball.
x30.reussite: The extra pass creates an open shot at the right time.
x30.vHard: Count open baskets as a team.

x31.objectif: Decide before dribbling, play smart rather than play a lot.
x31.placement: Attacker on the wing behind the arc, defender set.
etapes: (4 min) Catch, sell a fake before any dribble.
(3 min) Three dribbles max to finish, shot or drive.
(3 min) The defender gets the ball back and becomes the attacker.
x31.consignes: The first dribble wins the shoulder, every dribble must go somewhere.
x31.corrections: Demand a clear change of pace on the very first dribble.
x31.reussite: Finish in three dribbles or fewer.
x31.vHard: One dribble only, start off a closeout.

x32.titre: Two on two with a screen
x32.objectif: Chain screen, read and defense in a small space.
x32.placement: Two attackers, one of them a screener, two defenders.
etapes: (5 min) Free play off a ball screen.
(5 min) The defense picks its coverage, the offense reads and responds.
(4 min) Rebound, then fast transition the other way.
x32.consignes: Defensive talk on every screen, offensive read before the action.
x32.erreurs: No defensive talk on the screen, rushed offensive decision.
x32.corrections: Demand a defensive call on every screen.
x32.reussite: Every possession starts from a real read on both sides.
x32.vHard: Score on defensive stops rather than baskets.

x33.objectif: Play as a team in a small space with clear rules.
x33.placement: Three on three, a team waiting to replace the loser.
etapes: (5 min) At least one pass before shooting, cut after every pass.
(5 min) A stop and a rebound earn the ball and a bonus point.
(5 min) Teams rotate every two possessions.
x33.consignes: Move without the ball, fill the spaces, talk on defense.
x33.erreurs: Static play, nonstop one on one.
x33.corrections: Demand a cut after every pass.

x34.objectif: Decide fast with a man up and punish every help.
x34.placement: Four attackers around the arc, three defenders in the paint.
etapes: (5 min) Fast ball movement, two seconds max per player on the ball.
(5 min) The defense rotates and closes out, the offense looks for the open player.
(5 min) Basket or turnover, three new defenders, the offense stays on, then switch roles.
x34.consignes: The pass goes faster than the runner, attack the closeout, the extra pass makes the basket.
x34.erreurs: Ball handler holds the ball and plays alone.
x34.corrections: Limit each player to one second on the ball.
x34.reussite: The extra player is punished with an open pass.
x34.vHard: One second per player on the ball, count the open baskets.

x35.objectif: Push fast in the lanes and finish close to the rim.
x35.placement: Defensive rebound, three players, three lanes.
etapes: (4 min) Rebound, then a quick outlet pass to the point guard in the middle.
(4 min) The wings run their lanes, ball in the middle.
(4 min) Simple last pass, finish close to the rim.
x35.consignes: Run wide, ball in the middle, simple last pass, finish close to the rim.
x35.corrections: Remind them the simplest pass makes the open basket.
x35.reussite: The fast break ends as close as possible with no unnecessary dribble.
x35.vHard: One or two defenders getting back.

x36.objectif: Cut the opponent's run by getting back fast and talking.
x36.placement: Five offense, five defense, play starts on a shot.
etapes: (4 min) On every shot, defenders sprint back, one protects the rim.
(4 min) Talk: stop the ball first, then find your man.
(4 min) Count the transition baskets allowed.
x36.consignes: Sprint back on the shot, protect the rim first, talk to match up.
x36.erreurs: Lazy getting back, everyone watching their own shot.
x36.corrections: Count out loud the transition baskets given up.
x36.reussite: Zero easy transition baskets allowed over the set.
x36.vHard: A foul gives the ball and one point to the opponent.

x37.objectif: Decide fast with a man up, then defend a man down.
x37.placement: Three attackers against two defenders, continuous waves.
etapes: (5 min) The three fill the lanes, ball in the middle.
(5 min) Draw a defender, hit the open player near the rim.
(4 min) Two players head straight back the other way in a 2 on 1.
x37.consignes: Run wide, simple last pass, finish near the rim, get back right away.
x37.erreurs: Complicated last pass, no transition defense.
x37.corrections: Remind them of the simple pass and getting back right away.
x37.reussite: The advantage turns into a basket, the disadvantage is well defended.

x38.objectif: Attack the offensive rebound and finish on the second effort.
x38.placement: One shooter, two players under the rim, shot missed on purpose.
etapes: (4 min) As the shot goes up, the bigs win position.
(3 min) Attack the ball with two hands at its highest point.
(3 min) Put it back right away or kick it out, jump again if needed.
x38.consignes: Read the side of the rebound, attack the ball in the air, land on balanced feet.
x38.erreurs: Waiting for the ball, one effort only.
x38.corrections: Demand an immediate second jump if the first putback misses.
x38.reussite: The offensive rebound ends in a basket or a drawn foul.

x39.objectif: Make the delayed screen a reflex on every opponent shot.
x39.placement: Two players in the paint, the coach shoots from the free throw line.
etapes: (3 min) On the shot, the defender pivots and puts his back into contact.
(4 min) Wide base, elbows up, hold the contact for two seconds.
(3 min) Attack the ball with two hands at its highest point, balanced landing.
x39.consignes: Contact first, ball second. The player who watches the ball without touching his man loses the battle.
x39.erreurs: Going for the ball without boxing out.
x39.corrections: Penalize every rebound grabbed without contact first.
x39.reussite: Contact held, then rebound secured with two hands.
x39.vEasy: No shot, on the coach's signal.
x39.vHard: 2 on 2, the rebounding team attacks right away.

x40.objectif: Work on the defensive slide and a broken-down closeout on the shooter.
x40.placement: Zigzag course with cones, then a help start toward a spot.
etapes: (3 min) Low stance, slide from cone to cone without crossing your feet.
(4 min) Sprint the first two thirds, choppy steps on the last third.
(3 min) High hand on the ball side at the end of the closeout.
x40.consignes: Stay low, weight on the balls of your feet, don't bite on the fake.
x40.erreurs: Crossing the legs, flying in and getting beaten.
x40.corrections: Demand short, braking steps at the end of the approach.
x40.vHard: One on one after the catch, contain it.

x41.objectif: Build a defense that sees the ball, helps early and recovers fast.
x41.placement: Four attackers around the paint, four defenders on their man.
etapes: (6 min) On every pass, every defender adjusts one step toward the ball.
(5 min) On a pass to the perimeter, short, controlled closeout, hand high.
(5 min) Dribbling and drives allowed, the closest defender helps, another covers.
x41.consignes: See your man and the ball at the same time, talk on every pass, help early, recover fast.
x41.erreurs: Defender locked on his man, loses sight of the ball.
x41.corrections: Demand a call on every pass.
x41.reussite: Every pass triggers a team adjustment.
x41.vHard: Live four on four with rebounding and transition.

x42.objectif: Shift a 2-3 zone according to the position of the ball.
x42.placement: Five defenders in a 2-3, five attackers moving the ball.
etapes: (5 min) The zone shifts to the ball side, closing the baseline and the high post.
(5 min) On a ball reversal, the zone resets fast on the other side.
(5 min) Five-man rebound, every shooter accounted for.
x42.consignes: The zone moves with the ball, talk, protect the middle and the high post.
x42.erreurs: Static zone, high post left open.
x42.corrections: Assign one defender to the high post on every reversal.
x42.reussite: The zone is set before the ball arrives.
x42.vEasy: Slow ball movement to learn the shifts.
x42.vHard: Offense with a big at the high post and spread-out shooters.

x43.objectif: Apply full-court pressure to force a turnover.
x43.placement: Five defenders pressing after a made basket, five attackers inbounding.
etapes: (5 min) Pressure on the ball handler, force him toward the sideline.
(5 min) Trap in the corners, steal the forced pass.
(5 min) Steal and immediate transition to the rim.
x43.consignes: Force to the sideline, trap in the corner, close the passing lanes, convert fast.
x43.erreurs: Trapping in the middle, passing lanes open.
x43.corrections: Force the ball handler to the sideline before doubling.
x43.reussite: The press forces a turnover or a bad decision.
x43.vHard: Eight-second clock for the offense to cross half court.

x44.objectif: Break a full-court press without losing the ball.
x44.placement: Five attackers against a press, baseline inbound.
etapes: (5 min) One receiver comes short, another goes deep.
(5 min) Beat the first line with a pass, then advance through the middle.
(5 min) Ball in the middle, read the advantage and finish.
x44.consignes: One player in the middle always available, strong pass, ball toward the middle of the floor.
x44.erreurs: Dribbling into the corners, passes along the sideline.
x44.corrections: Move the ball through the middle, never along the sideline.
x44.reussite: The press is broken and ends in a numbers advantage.
x44.vEasy: Passive press that gives up the first pass.
x44.vHard: Eight-second clock to cross half court.

x45.objectif: Stay in front of your attacker without touching him.
x45.placement: One attacker, one defender, from half court to the rim.
etapes: (4 min) The attacker dribbles toward the rim.
(3 min) The defender slides and forces him toward the sideline.
(3 min) A stop without a foul is worth one point for the defender.
x45.consignes: Wide stance, active hands that don't grab, body in front.
x45.erreurs: Using the hands to make up for being late.
x45.corrections: Penalize every hand put on the attacker.
x45.reussite: Stop made without any hand contact.

x46.objectif: Set a simple inbound play under the basket.
x46.placement: Five attackers on a baseline inbound, five seconds to pass.
etapes: (4 min) A screener frees a first receiver at the rim.
(4 min) Second option, kick-out to the perimeter for an open shot.
(4 min) Repeat with defense from halfway through.
x46.consignes: Timing on the screens, first option at the rim, second on the perimeter, strong inbound pass.
x46.erreurs: Screens with no timing, five seconds called.
x46.corrections: Count the five seconds out loud to set the rhythm.
x46.reussite: The inbound finds an open option in time.
x46.vHard: Aggressive defense on the passing lanes.

x47.objectif: Manage the end of a game, one ball to win.
x47.placement: Five on five, close imaginary score, fourteen seconds on the clock.
etapes: (4 min) The offense looks for a good shot before time runs out.
(4 min) The defense is not allowed to foul.
(4 min) Play it again with roles reversed.
x47.consignes: A clear plan, a first option, a second if it gets taken away, keep a cool head.
x47.erreurs: Improvising with no plan, rushed shot.
x47.corrections: Set the play before the inbound.
x47.reussite: The team gets a good shot in time, not the first one available.
x47.vHard: Eight seconds on a sideline inbound.

x48.objectif: Develop hops and above all the quality of the landing.
x48.placement: A line of small hurdles, one player at a time.
etapes: (4 min) Two-foot jumps over low hurdles, 4 sets of 6 jumps, soft, quiet landing, 30 seconds rest.
(4 min) Single-leg hop, stable landing held for one second, 3 sets of 5 per leg.
(4 min) Jump, then a short 4-meter sprint, 6 reps, full recovery.
x48.consignes: Quiet landing, knees in line with the feet, no caving in. Land soft on the balls of the feet. Progression: raise the hurdles only when the landing stays stable and quiet.
x48.corrections: Demand a landing held for one second before the next hurdle.
x48.reussite: Stable, quiet landings for the whole set.
x48.vHard: Single-leg hops with a change of direction on landing.

x49.objectif: Strengthen footing and balance to limit sprains.
x49.placement: Everyone in place, the coach runs the clock.
etapes: (3 min) Balance on one foot, 3 times 30 seconds per leg, eyes open, then closed on the last one.
(4 min) Controlled forward and reverse lunges, 3 sets of 8 per leg, knee in line with the foot.
(3 min) Small lateral hops from one foot to the other, 3 sets of 10, landing held for one second before the next hop.
x49.consignes: Knee always in line with the toes, never caving in. Soft landing, core tight. Progression: eyes closed, then on an unstable surface if you have one. Stop at the first sign of joint pain.
x49.erreurs: Knee caving in on the landing.
x49.corrections: Slow down and fix the knee-foot alignment before going again.
x49.reussite: Balance held and stable landings with no knee caving in.
x49.vHard: On a balance pad, eyes closed.

x50.objectif: Dribble while walking and set the ball down, building your castle.
x50.placement: A pile of balls in the middle, one hoop castle per team.
etapes: (2 min) The story: each team has to fill its castle with balls.
(4 min) On the signal, each child dribbles to get a ball and drops it in the hoop.
(2 min) The team with the most balls built the biggest castle.
x50.consignes: One ball at a time, dribble while walking to the castle, head up.
x50.erreurs: Ball carried in the arms, running without dribbling.
x50.corrections: Remind the rule: we dribble, one ball at a time.
x50.reussite: The children dribble while walking without losing the ball.
x50.vHard: Dribble required both ways, weak hand.

x51.objectif: Hold a credible triple-threat stance and fool the defender with a jab step.
x51.placement: Everyone with a ball on the wing, an imaginary defender in front.
etapes: (3 min) Catch in triple threat, ball near the strong hip, pivot foot set.
(3 min) Short, quick jab step, back to position.
(2 min) Jab, then drive or set shot depending on the reaction played.
x51.consignes: Stay low and balanced, the jab has to be a real threat, the pivot foot doesn't move.
x51.corrections: Demand a short, sharp jab and check the pivot foot stays planted.
x51.reussite: The jab makes an imaginary defender react before the real choice.
x51.vHard: Live defender who reacts to the jab.

x52.objectif: Lift the defender with a shot fake to attack the rim.
x52.placement: On the wing, a cone or passive defender in front.
etapes: (3 min) High, believable shot fake, ball goes up to the forehead.
(3 min) Explosive first step on the dribble after the fake.
(2 min) Finish or pull-up depending on the space given.
x52.consignes: The fake looks like the real shot, the first step gets past the defender's shoulder.
x52.erreurs: Fake too low, travel on the start.
x52.corrections: Bring the ball up as if shooting, keep the pivot foot down until the dribble.
x52.reussite: The fake lifts the defender and opens the drive.

x53.objectif: Start an attack with a dribble hand-off.
x53.placement: A ball handler dribbling toward a teammate who comes to get it.
etapes: (4 min) The ball handler dribbles toward the receiver and hands him the ball.
(4 min) The passer follows with a screen, like a pick and roll.
(2 min) The receiver reads the coverage and chooses shot, drive or pass.
x53.consignes: Hand-off protected close to the body, receiver changes pace on the catch.
x53.erreurs: Readable hand-off, receiver standing still on the catch.
x53.corrections: Shoulders tight and demand a burst on the catch.
x53.reussite: The action creates a shot or a drive.

x54.titre: Catch and shoot off a screen
x54.objectif: Come off a screen, catch and shoot with no dead time.
x54.placement: A shooter behind a screen, a screener, a passer.
etapes: (4 min) The shooter comes off the screen shoulder to shoulder and straight up.
(4 min) Catch with hands ready, balanced stop, shoot right away.
(4 min) Alternate both sides of the screen.
x54.consignes: Come off the screen tight, target hands before the ball, feet ready to shoot.
x54.erreurs: Coming off too wide, hands low on the catch.
x54.corrections: Have the shooter brush the screen and get the hands ready early.
x54.reussite: Shot loaded right after a balanced catch.
x54.vHard: A defender chasing over the screen.

x55.objectif: Create space for a shot with a controlled step back.
x55.placement: Start on the dribble toward a cone defender, on the wing or at the top of the key.
etapes: (4 min) Attack the cone, then a step-back dribble.
(3 min) Balanced stop after the step back, weight centered.
(3 min) Shot loaded on balance despite moving back.
x55.consignes: Sharp step back, balanced stop, same shooting mechanics.
x55.erreurs: Off-balance step back, shot fading away.
x55.corrections: Work the stop first, the shot only once the balance is stable.
x55.reussite: Stable shot despite the step back, without fading away.
x55.vEasy: Step back with no shot, find your balance.
x55.vHard: Step back after real contact from a defender.

x56.objectif: Be ready to shoot in the corner when the ball is swung.
x56.placement: A shooter in the corner, one or two passers swinging the ball.
etapes: (4 min) Quick swing from one side to the other, the corner gets the ball.
(4 min) Catch with hands ready, feet facing the rim.
(2 min) Shoot right away, then switch corners.
x56.consignes: Get your feet ready before the ball, the corner shoots fast because the help comes from far away.
x56.erreurs: Feet not lined up, hesitation before the shot.
x56.corrections: Line your feet up with the rim as soon as the ball heads your way.
x56.reussite: Shot loaded on the catch in the corner.
x56.vHard: A closeout coming from the inside.

x57.objectif: Install a stable, repeatable free-throw routine.
x57.placement: At the free throw line, alone or in pairs with a rebounder.
etapes: (3 min) Same preparation every shot, same feet, same breathing.
(3 min) Sets of five, record the makes.
(2 min) Two free throws after a short effort, like in a game.
x57.consignes: Same routine every time, breathe before you release, follow through with the wrist.
x57.corrections: Lock in the routine: same motion, same rhythm, shot after shot.
x57.reussite: Identical routine and steady percentage across the sets.
x57.vEasy: No counting, focus on a consistent motion.
x57.vHard: Two free throws after a sprint, with something riding on the score.

x58.objectif: Finish on the far side of the rim to protect the ball from the block.
x58.placement: Start from the baseline, finish under the basket.
etapes: (4 min) Run under the rim, finish on the other side, off the opposite glass.
(2 min) Protect the ball with your body between the defender and the rim.
(2 min) Alternate both sides.
x58.consignes: Go under the rim, protect with your body, find the angle off the opposite glass.
x58.erreurs: Finish exposed to the block, wrong angle off the glass.
x58.corrections: Have the player go under the rim and aim for the opposite small square.
x58.reussite: Protected finish that avoids the block.
x58.vEasy: From a standstill under the rim.

x59.objectif: Finish despite contact and keep balance.
x59.placement: A finisher, a teammate giving controlled contact in the paint.
x59.materiel: 1 ball, a contact pad or a teammate
etapes: (4 min) Drive, absorb the contact on your feet, strong finish.
(3 min) Look for the foul while finishing.
(3 min) Alternate sides and hands.
x59.consignes: Absorb the contact on your feet, keep the ball strong, finish, then look for the glass.
x59.erreurs: Contact knocks you off balance, ball lost.
x59.corrections: Strengthen the base on contact and protect the ball with two hands if needed.
x59.vHard: Strong contact and a shot blocker.

x60.objectif: Set an unstoppable inside shot over the defender.
x60.placement: A big on the low post, back to the rim.
etapes: (4 min) Catch with your back to the basket, step toward the middle of the paint.
(3 min) Turn, ball raised away from the defender, hook shot.
(3 min) Alternate both shoulders.
x60.consignes: Ball high and protected, shoot with the arm extended over the top, solid base.
x60.corrections: Raise the ball higher and keep it away from the defender.
x60.reussite: Hook shot released out of the blocker's reach.

x61.titre: Up and under at the post
x61.objectif: Lift the defender with a fake then finish underneath.
x61.placement: A big in the low post, a defender, a passer.
etapes: (4 min) Catch, believable hook fake to lift the defender.
(3 min) Step-through under the defender who jumped.
(3 min) Protected finish on the other side.
x61.consignes: The fake looks like the real shot, the step goes under the defender, ball protected.
x61.erreurs: Soft fake, travel on the step-through.
x61.corrections: Make the fake believable and count the pivot foot.
x61.reussite: The fake lifts the defender, the finish goes underneath.
x61.vEasy: Passive defender who jumps on the fake.
x61.vHard: Disciplined defender who stays down, forcing another read.

x62.objectif: Start the transition with a fast first pass after the rebound.
x62.placement: A rebounder, an outlet on the side, a wing on the run.
etapes: (4 min) Two-hand rebound, pivot to the outside, strong outlet pass.
(3 min) The outlet turns to face the play and hits the wing on the run.
(3 min) Transition finish at the other end.
x62.consignes: Protect the rebound, pivot to the outside, sharp and quick outlet pass.
x62.erreurs: Rebound exposed in the middle, slow outlet.
x62.corrections: Demand a pivot toward the sideline before the pass.
x62.reussite: The first pass goes out fast and starts the break.

x63.objectif: Swing the ball with a long pass once the help has committed.
x63.placement: Two attackers on one side, a shooter on the opposite side, a defense that helps.
etapes: (4 min) The ball handler attacks, the weak-side help shifts toward the ball.
(3 min) Long, sharp pass to the shooter left open on the opposite side.
(3 min) The shooter catches and loads up right away.
x63.consignes: Read when the help leaves, pass hard and early, aim for the shooter's hands.
x63.erreurs: Lob pass that gets picked off, late decision.
x63.corrections: Anticipate the help's movement and put zip on the pass.
x63.reussite: The pass finds the open shooter before the help recovers.
x63.vEasy: No defense, walk through the passing lanes.
x63.vHard: Help defender who fakes to bait the pass.

x64.titre: Give and go to the rim
x64.objectif: Chain a pass and an immediate cut to the rim.
x64.placement: Two perimeter players and a big as the relay, no defense to start.
etapes: (4 min) Pass then hard cut to the rim, hands ready.
(4 min) The relay hands the ball back on the move if the cut is open.
(2 min) Finish, then refill the spots.
x64.consignes: Cut right after the pass, hands ready, fill the space you left.
x64.corrections: Demand a sharp cut after every pass.
x64.reussite: The cut opens up an easy finish at the rim.
x64.vHard: One defender who follows the cut.

x65.titre: UCLA cut off a vertical screen
x65.objectif: Free a cut to the rim with a screen from the high-post big.
x65.placement: A point guard who passes to the wing, a big at the high post, a cutter.
etapes: (4 min) Point guard passes to the wing, then cuts off the high-post screen.
(4 min) The cutter looks for the ball on the way to the rim.
(4 min) If it's closed, kick-out and keep the offense going.
x65.consignes: Pass then cut tight off the screen, hands ready, pop back out if the cut is closed.
x65.erreurs: Cut too wide, misses the screen.
x65.corrections: Make the cutter brush shoulders with the high-post screen.
x65.reussite: The cut goes tight off the screen and gets open.

x66.objectif: Set an offensive continuity with a baseline screen and a flex cut.
x66.placement: Five attackers in flex alignment, no defense to start.
etapes: (5 min) Baseline screen for the cutter running along the baseline.
(5 min) The screener comes up to catch at the high post.
(4 min) Repeat the continuity on one side, then the other.
x66.consignes: Time the screens, cut along the baseline, smooth continuity with no dead time.
x66.erreurs: Screens with no timing, continuity breaks down.
x66.corrections: Start the cut when the screen is set.
x66.reussite: The continuity runs on both sides with no hesitation.
x66.vHard: Defense that fights through the screens.

x67.objectif: Create a choice for the guard between two screens at the top.
x67.placement: Two bigs at the elbows, two perimeter players in the corners, point guard at the top.
etapes: (5 min) The point guard picks one of the two screens and attacks.
(5 min) The big not used rolls or pops depending on the coverage.
(4 min) The corners stay ready for the extra pass.
x67.consignes: Get your read before the screen, read the coverage, punish the help with the pass.
x67.erreurs: Screen chosen before reading the defense.
x67.corrections: Have the defense call its coverage to force the read.
x67.reussite: The point guard picks the screen based on the defense and creates an advantage.
x67.vEasy: Passive defense that calls its coverage.
x67.vHard: Defense that switches and helps from the weak side.

x68.objectif: Run a motion offense with no fixed set, on simple rules.
x68.placement: Five attackers spread around the arc, no fixed big.
etapes: (5 min) Rule: every pass is followed by a cut or a screen.
(5 min) Fill the open spot, the ball moves with no dribble.
(5 min) Add a defense to read and punish.
x68.consignes: Pass and move, keep your spacing, read the defense instead of running a script.
x68.corrections: Demand an action after every pass and proper spacing.
x68.reussite: Ball and players keep moving, the gaps stay open.
x68.vHard: Aggressive defense that packs the middle.

x69.objectif: Free a shooter with a screen set away from the ball.
x69.placement: A ball handler on one side, a shooter and a screener on the other.
etapes: (4 min) The screener goes to screen the shooter's defender on the weak side.
(4 min) The shooter comes off the screen into open space.
(4 min) Quick swing and shot coming off.
x69.consignes: Still, legal screen, the shooter comes off fast, the ball handler swings it at the right time.
x69.corrections: Freeze the screen on contact and sync the swing.
x69.reussite: The shooter comes off open on the weak side for a clean look.
x69.vHard: Defense that fights through the screen and helps.

x70.objectif: Defend the pick and roll by dropping the big to protect the rim.
x70.placement: A ball handler and a screener, two defenders in drop coverage.
etapes: (5 min) The big drops below the screen, ready to contain the drive.
(5 min) The ball handler's defender chases over the screen to recover.
(4 min) The big steps back up to his man once the ball handler is contained.
x70.consignes: The big protects the rim by dropping, the guard chases hard, talk on the screen.
x70.erreurs: Big too high, paint left open.
x70.corrections: Have the big drop to the free throw line.
x70.reussite: The drive is contained without opening up the rim.
x70.vHard: Offense that hits the roller quickly.
x70.stats: Points allowed on pick and roll

x71.objectif: Counter the pick and roll with a brief hedge then a recovery.
x71.placement: A ball handler and a screener, two defenders in hedge coverage.
etapes: (5 min) The big shows a short hedge on the ball handler to slow the drive.
(5 min) The ball handler's defender recovers fast over the screen.
(4 min) The big gets back to his man as early as possible, weak-side help in support.
x71.consignes: Short, controlled hedge, fast recovery, constant communication.
x71.erreurs: Hedge too high, roller left free.
x71.corrections: Limit the hedge to two steps before recovering.
x71.reussite: The ball handler is slowed and the big gets back to his man in time.
x71.vHard: Offense that makes the pass to the roller.
x71.stats: Points allowed on pick and roll

x72.objectif: Switch cleanly on the screen without leaving space.
x72.placement: A ball handler and a screener, two defenders who switch.
etapes: (4 min) Call the switch before the screen makes contact.
(4 min) Swap players with no gap, body in front.
(4 min) The new on-ball defender contains, the other one takes the roller.
x72.consignes: Call it early, switch body to body, give no space on the switch.
x72.erreurs: Silent, late switch, space left for the ball handler.
x72.corrections: Demand the call before contact and a tight switch.
x72.reussite: The switch happens with no easy basket given up.
x72.vHard: Offense that hunts the size mismatch after the switch.
x72.stats: Points allowed on pick and roll

x73.titre: Steer the handler away from the screen
x73.objectif: Push the handler to the side opposite the screen to reject the pick and roll.
x73.placement: A ball handler and a screener, two defenders who ice the screen.
etapes: (4 min) The ball handler's defender positions to send him toward the sideline.
(4 min) The big steps up on the screen side to close off the way back.
(4 min) Force the ball handler toward the help, away from the screen.
x73.consignes: Body angled to deny the screen, send him to the sideline, help ready on the strong side.
x73.erreurs: The ball handler still gets back to the screen.
x73.corrections: Set your foot and shoulder to close off the way back to the screen.
x73.reussite: The ball handler is sent away from the screen, toward the help.
x73.vHard: Offense that sets a second screen.
x73.stats: Points allowed on pick and roll

x74.objectif: Deny the catch to an off-ball attacker near yours.
x74.placement: A ball handler, a potential receiver, a defender denying.
etapes: (4 min) The defender puts a hand in the passing lane, partly back to the ball.
(4 min) He adjusts his feet when the receiver moves, without getting beaten on the cut.
(2 min) On a backdoor cut, open up to the rim so you don't get beaten.
x74.consignes: One hand in the lane, see your man and the ball, open up on the backdoor cut.
x74.erreurs: Denying without seeing the ball, backdoor given up.
x74.corrections: Keep the ball in your field of vision and anticipate the cut.
x74.reussite: The catch is delayed without getting beaten backdoor.
x74.vHard: Receiver who alternates between flashing and a backdoor cut.

x75.objectif: Help on the drive then rotate to cover the open player.
x75.placement: Three attackers, three defenders, a drive set up.
etapes: (5 min) On the drive, the weak-side defender helps at the rim.
(5 min) The next defender rotates to cover the helper's man.
(4 min) Closeout on the shooter after the pass.
x75.consignes: Help early at the rim, rotate to cover, controlled closeout on the pass.
x75.erreurs: Late help, no rotation, open shot given up.
x75.corrections: Anticipate the help and call out the rotation.
x75.reussite: The drive is stopped and the open player is covered.
x75.vHard: Offense that makes the extra pass.
x75.stats: Points allowed, open shots given up

x76.objectif: Close out fast on a corner shooter without getting beaten baseline.
x76.placement: A help defender, a shooter in the corner, a passer.
etapes: (4 min) Pass to the corner, the defender sprints then brakes.
(3 min) Choppy steps, hand high, take away the baseline.
(3 min) One on one if the attacker drives, contain toward the middle.
x76.consignes: Sprint the first two-thirds, chop your feet, take away the baseline.
x76.erreurs: Flying in and getting beaten baseline.
x76.corrections: Brake on the last steps and steer him toward the inside help.
x76.reussite: The shot is contested without getting beaten baseline.
x76.vEasy: Closeout only, no one on one.
x76.vHard: The shooter attacks right after a shot fake.

x77.objectif: Disrupt passes and dribbles with active hands without fouling.
x77.placement: A ball handler, a defender, from half court to the rim.
etapes: (3 min) The defender keeps his hands low and quick in the passing lanes.
(3 min) On the dribble, low hand pokes at the ball with no body contact.
(2 min) Count deflections with no foul over one minute.
x77.consignes: Quick, low hands, poke the ball, never the player's arm.
x77.erreurs: High hands that do nothing, body contact called.
x77.corrections: Bring the hands down toward the ball and attack the dribble low.
x77.reussite: Several deflections with no foul at all.
x77.vHard: Ball handler who actively protects the ball.

x78.titre: One on one, back to the rim
x78.objectif: Attack and defend an inside one on one.
x78.placement: An attacker in the low post with his back to the rim, a defender, a passer.
etapes: (4 min) Catch with your back to the basket, ball protected, read the defender.
(3 min) Two dribbles max to finish, drop step or hook.
(3 min) The defender pushes him out of his comfort zone, then rotate.
x78.consignes: Seal your defender, ball high and strong, two dribbles max.
x78.corrections: Limit to two dribbles and keep the ball tight to the chin.
x78.reussite: Clean finish in two dribbles max.
x78.vHard: Weak-side help that comes to double.

x79.titre: Two on two, help and recover
x79.objectif: Defend the drive with two, then recover to your man.
x79.placement: Two attackers, two defenders, a drive set up.
etapes: (5 min) On the drive, the second defender helps at the rim.
(5 min) Quick closeout back on your man after the pass.
(4 min) Rebound, then transition the other way.
x79.consignes: Help early, talk, get back fast with a controlled closeout on your shooter.
x79.erreurs: Helper stays stuck, open shot given up.
x79.corrections: Help then recover right away, call the rotation.
x79.reussite: The drive is stopped and the shooter stays covered.
x79.vHard: Offense that makes the extra pass.

x80.objectif: Buy time with two defenders against three attackers in transition.
x80.placement: Three attackers on the run, two defenders in tandem.
etapes: (4 min) One defender up top slows the ball handler, the other protects the rim.
(4 min) They talk and move up and down in tandem based on the pass.
(4 min) Hold until a third defender gets back.
x80.consignes: One high, one low, talk, stall until the help gets back.
x80.erreurs: Both on the same level, easy basket given up.
x80.corrections: Stagger the two defenders and make them talk.
x80.reussite: The numbers disadvantage is defended with no easy basket right away.
x80.vHard: Offense that runs fast and spreads out.

x81.objectif: Delay two attackers alone until a teammate gets back.
x81.placement: Two attackers on the run, one defender.
etapes: (4 min) The defender backs up to the rim and fakes stepping up on the ball handler.
(3 min) He takes away the first easy pass and buys time.
(3 min) He holds until a second defender gets back.
x81.consignes: Back up to the rim, fake the commit, take away the obvious pass, buy time.
x81.erreurs: Commits too early on the ball handler, who hits his teammate.
x81.corrections: Make the defender back up and delay his commit.
x81.reussite: The easy finish is delayed until the help gets back.
x81.vHard: Offense that plays fast and wide.

x82.titre: Team box out and tag up
x82.objectif: Make the box out a team reflex on every opponent shot.
x82.placement: Five attackers, five defenders, shot triggered by the coach.
etapes: (5 min) On the shot, every defender finds his man and gets his back into contact.
(5 min) Hold the contact, then attack the ball with two hands.
(2 min) On an opponent offensive rebound, tag up again and make contact again.
x82.consignes: Contact first, everyone takes his man, two-hand grab on the ball.
x82.erreurs: Going to the ball without contact, one player forgotten.
x82.corrections: Demand contact on every shot before going for the rebound.
x82.reussite: No offensive rebound given up over the set.
x82.vHard: Offense that crashes the offensive glass hard.

x83.objectif: Extend an offensive rebound with a tip or a controlled second jump.
x83.placement: One player under the rim, the coach or a teammate shoots to miss.
etapes: (3 min) One-hand tip toward the rim, firm wrist.
(3 min) If the tip doesn't go in, two-hand catch and second jump.
(2 min) Chain both moves on both sides.
x83.consignes: Firm wrist on the tip, if you catch it, land balanced before the second jump.
x83.corrections: Firm up the wrist on the tip, steady your feet before jumping again.
x83.reussite: The offensive rebound ends in a made tip or a second effort.

x84.objectif: Set a sideline inbound that finds a safe option.
x84.placement: Five attackers on a sideline inbound, five seconds to pass.
etapes: (4 min) A first short cut guarantees a safe inbound.
(4 min) A screen frees a shooter or a cut to the rim.
(2 min) Repeat with defense from the halfway point on.
x84.consignes: Always a safe inbound option available, time the screens, strong inbound pass.
x84.erreurs: No safe option, five seconds called.
x84.corrections: Set a guaranteed short receiver before looking for the shot option.
x84.reussite: The inbound finds an option within the time.
x84.vHard: Aggressive defense on the passing lanes.

x85.objectif: Manage the end of a game down three points.
x85.placement: Five on five, down three, ten seconds on the clock.
etapes: (4 min) Commit to a choice: three to tie, or a two then foul.
(4 min) Run the chosen option without rushing.
(4 min) Replay with different time left.
x85.consignes: Decide before the inbound, a good three or a two then a quick foul, keep a cool head.
x85.erreurs: Unclear choice, rushed and contested shot.
x85.corrections: Set the option before the inbound and the foul plan if needed.
x85.reussite: The team runs the chosen plan and gives itself a real chance.
x85.vHard: Six seconds on a sideline inbound.

x86.objectif: Foul fast and clean when ahead, or attack the opponent's foul calmly.
x86.placement: Five on five, close score, short clock, intentional foul situation.
etapes: (4 min) Up by a little, immediate clean foul before the shot.
(3 min) On offense, safe inbound to take the foul in the right spot.
(3 min) Free throws, then inbound and defense.
x86.consignes: Quick foul on the ball handler before the shot, on offense keep a safe outlet and a good shooter on the ball.
x86.erreurs: Foul too late that allows the shot, shaky ball handler who loses the ball.
x86.corrections: Foul before the shooting motion, put the ball in the hands of a good free throw shooter.
x86.reussite: The foul comes in time, the offense secures the ball.
x86.vHard: Very short clock and team foul management.

x87.objectif: Build specific endurance while keeping ball control.
x87.placement: Start on the baseline, markers on the court lines.
etapes: (4 min) Dribble out and back to each line, weak hand on the way back, 4 sets, stop sharply at every line.
(3 min) Finish with a layup at each end, alternating right and left hand.
(3 min) Timed 30-second sets, 4 reps, 30 seconds of recovery, ball control comes first.
x87.consignes: Ball control before speed, head up, sharp stop on both feet at the lines. Progression: cut rest to 20 seconds, weak hand only for the whole drill.
x87.erreurs: Ball lost as soon as intensity goes up.
x87.corrections: Slow down until you keep control, then build back up.
x87.reussite: Sets completed with no turnover despite fatigue.
x87.vHard: Weak hand only on the way back.

x88.objectif: Strengthen defensive footing and the lower body in a low stance.
x88.placement: Two cones apart, start in a defensive stance.
etapes: (3 min) Lateral slides from one cone to the other over 4 meters, 4 sets of 20 seconds, stay low.
(3 min) Touch each cone with the low hand without standing up, 4 trips per set.
(2 min) 20-second sets at max intensity, 3 reps, 40 seconds of rest between them.
x88.consignes: Stay low the whole time, weight on the balls of your feet, feet slide and never cross, flat back. Progression: move the cones farther apart, add a change of direction on signal.
x88.corrections: Lower your center of gravity and keep a wide base.
x88.reussite: Low stance held for the whole set.
x88.vHard: Add a visual signal that changes direction.

x89.objectif: Combine sprint, slide and backpedal in a quick course.
x89.placement: Four cones in a T, start at the foot of the T.
etapes: (3 min) Forward sprint to the middle cone over 5 meters, 5 reps, walk back.
(3 min) Lateral slides to the side cones without crossing your feet, touch the cone with the low hand, 4 trips each side.
(2 min) Full timed course: forward, slides, backpedal, 4 runs, full recovery.
x89.consignes: Quick, low feet on changes of direction, slide without crossing, balanced backpedal with hips low. Progression: time it and try to beat your time without losing clean footwork.
x89.erreurs: Slow feet on the turns, chest up.
x89.corrections: Break down your speed before each change and stay low.
x89.reussite: Smooth course with no loss of balance on the changes.
x89.vHard: Timed, players racing each other's times.

x90.objectif: Prepare shoulders and wrists for shooting repetitions.
x90.placement: Everyone in place, the coach leads.
etapes: (3 min) Shoulder circles forward and backward, then straight-arm rotations, 2 sets of 15 each way, gradually bigger range.
(3 min) Wrist flexions and extensions holding a light ball, 3 sets of 12, then slow wrist rotations.
(2 min) Band strengthening, shoulder pulls and external rotations, 2 sets of 12, light tension.
x90.consignes: Controlled range, slow and steady movements, no pain. Do it before shooting sets and as maintenance twice a week. Progression: increase band tension, never speed.
x90.erreurs: Jerky movements, too much range when cold.
x90.corrections: Slow down and reduce the range at the start.
x90.reussite: Shoulders and wrists mobile and warm before shooting sets.

x91.objectif: Press full court in a diamond to force the ball up the sidelines.
x91.placement: Five defenders in a 1-2-1-1 after a made basket, five attackers on the inbound.
etapes: (5 min) The first defender pushes the inbound to one side.
(5 min) The tandem traps in the corner, the safety reads the longest pass.
(5 min) Steal and immediate transition to the rim.
x91.consignes: Push it to one side, trap in the corner, the safety anticipates the long pass, convert fast.
x91.erreurs: Trap in the middle, safety out of position.
x91.corrections: Force it to the sideline before trapping, set the safety on the long pass.
x91.reussite: The press forces a turnover or a bad decision.

x92.titre: Attacking the zone through the middle
x92.objectif: Crack a zone by occupying the high post and the gaps.
x92.placement: Five attackers against a 2-3 zone, one player at the high post.
etapes: (5 min) Ball to the high post to freeze the zone, read the gaps.
(5 min) Quick ball reversals to make the zone shift late.
(4 min) Shot in the gap or finish at the rim through the crack.
x92.consignes: Fill the high post, play fast into the gaps, reverse the ball faster than the zone shifts.
x92.erreurs: Slow offense that lets the zone reset.
x92.corrections: Speed up the reversals and fill the middle.
x92.reussite: The zone shifts late and leaves a gap open.

x93.objectif: Chain a pass then an off-ball screen in a simple set.
x93.placement: Five attackers, two passes then a set screen.
etapes: (4 min) First pass and cut, the ball changes sides.
(4 min) The passer goes to set an off-ball screen for a shooter.
(4 min) Swing and shot coming off the screen, otherwise run it again.
x93.consignes: Pass then go screen, time the swing, shooter comes off fast.
x93.erreurs: Screen with no timing, late swing.
x93.corrections: Time the screen to the ball swing.
x93.reussite: The shooter comes off open at the right time.
x93.vHard: Defense that fights through the screens.

x94.objectif: Master front and reverse pivots without traveling, ball protected.
x94.placement: Everyone with a ball in hand, in triple-threat position.
etapes: (3 min) Front and reverse pivot, pivot foot locked to the floor.
(3 min) Pivot, then pass or shot setup.
(2 min) Pivot to protect the ball from an imaginary defender.
x94.consignes: The pivot foot stays put, ball protected close to the body, chest low.
x94.corrections: Lock the pivot foot and keep the ball near the strong-side hip.
x94.reussite: Clean pivots with no travel, ball protected.
x94.vHard: Live defender going for the ball.

x95.objectif: Turn and shoot after a catch coming from the side.
x95.placement: A shooter on the move, a passer off to the side.
etapes: (4 min) The shooter cuts and catches the ball coming from the side.
(4 min) He squares his feet to the rim as he catches.
(2 min) Immediate shot, then switch the passing side.
x95.consignes: Turn shoulders and feet to the rim on the catch, hands ready.
x95.corrections: Point the front foot at the rim as soon as you catch.
x95.reussite: Loaded, balanced shot despite the pass coming from the side.
x95.vHard: A defender who comes to contest.

x96.objectif: Dribble fast while keeping control, chased by a hawk.
x96.placement: Dribblers on one side, one or two hawks without a ball in the middle.
etapes: (2 min) Story: cross without the hawk touching your ball.
(4 min) On the signal, dribble across, the dribbler who gets touched joins the hawks.
(2 min) Play again until the last dribbler, who wins.
x96.consignes: Protect your ball, switch hands to dodge, keep your head up.
x96.erreurs: The kids stop dead and lose the ball.
x96.corrections: Teach them to change direction while still dribbling.
x96.reussite: The kids cross while keeping the ball under control.

x97.objectif: Dribble on the move then stop balanced on the signal.
x97.placement: All the kids dribble freely in a square.
etapes: (2 min) Dribble everywhere while listening to the coach.
(3 min) On the signal, everyone freezes like a statue, ball held, balanced.
(2 min) Anyone still moving makes a funny face, then off we go again.
x97.consignes: Dribble head up, on the signal stop balanced, ball held tight.
x97.corrections: Show the stop with knees bent and the ball held tight.
x97.reussite: The whole group stops sharp and steady on the signal.

x98.objectif: Discover passing and waiting your turn in a joyful relay.
x98.placement: Two teams in lines, facing a relay partner.
etapes: (3 min) Two-hand chest pass to the relay, then run behind him.
(3 min) The relay passes back to the next one in line.
(2 min) The first team to get everyone through wins.
x98.consignes: Pass to your buddy's chest, hands ready to catch, wait your turn.
x98.erreurs: Pass too hard or at the feet, pushing and shoving.
x98.corrections: Show the soft pass to the chest and how to stand in line.
x98.reussite: The passes reach the hands, everyone waits their turn.

x99.objectif: Move in the chair, respecting the two-push rule before dribbling.
x99.placement: Players in wheelchairs, a simple course to the rim.
etapes: (4 min) Two pushes max, then a dribble, a pass, or a shot.
(3 min) Pushes and dribble chained on a slalom.
(3 min) Finish at the rim following the rule.
x99.consignes: Count your pushes, a dribble resets the count, keep control of the ball on your lap between actions.
x99.erreurs: More than two pushes without a dribble, ball falling off.
x99.corrections: Count the pushes out loud and fit the dribble in before the third.
x99.reussite: Smooth movement without breaking the two-push rule.
x99.vHard: Fast slalom and finish on the move.

x100.objectif: Force passing and movement by banning the dribble.
x100.placement: Three on three or four on four, no dribbling allowed.
etapes: (4 min) Move the ball only by passing and cutting.
(4 min) Every pass is followed by a cut or a screen.
(4 min) A stop and a rebound give the ball to the defending team.
x100.consignes: Pass and move, fill the spaces, hands ready, nobody stands still.
x100.erreurs: Players go static as soon as the dribble is gone.
x100.corrections: Demand an action after every pass and reward movement.
x100.reussite: The team scores only through movement and passing.
x100.vHard: At least two passes before shooting.

x101.objectif: Score on the move over the help before it steps up.
x101.placement: Start dribbling from the wing, a tall obstacle in the paint.
etapes: (4 min) Two dribbles toward the paint, one-foot takeoff, ball pushed up high and soft.
(3 min) Release the ball early, before you reach contact.
(3 min) Find the angle off the glass on both sides.
x101.consignes: Balanced jump, soft wrist, ball released before the help arrives.
x101.erreurs: Shot too late, at the defender's level.
x101.corrections: Release earlier and higher, right off the second dribble.
x101.reussite: The shot drops into the rim over the obstacle.
x101.vHard: Live help that steps up to block.

x102.objectif: Set a stable shot after one or two dribbles.
x102.placement: Start on the wing or at the top, a cone as the defender.
etapes: (4 min) One attack dribble, then balanced stop, mid-range shot.
(3 min) Same move after a change of direction.
(3 min) Alternate both sides.
x102.consignes: Low, balanced stop, same mechanics as a set shot, follow through with the wrist.
x102.corrections: Freeze the stop before loading up, weight centered.
x102.reussite: Loaded, steady shot off the dribble.
x102.vHard: Shot after three dribbles, with a defender.

x103.objectif: Shoot from deep arriving behind the transition play.
x103.placement: Two players on the run, a trailer following.
etapes: (4 min) Quick push up the floor, the trailer arrives behind at the top.
(3 min) Drop-back pass to the trailer, immediate three.
(3 min) Alternate the side the trailer arrives on.
x103.consignes: Run behind the play, hands ready, shot loaded on the catch.
x103.erreurs: The trailer arrives too early and clogs the space.
x103.corrections: Time the trailer's arrival just after the first wave.
x103.reussite: Open, loaded shot at the top in transition.
x103.vHard: A defender who closes out fast on the trailer.

x104.titre: Create your shot off the dribble
x104.objectif: Get free from a close defender to load up a shot.
x104.placement: Start dribbling toward a cone, on the wing or at the top.
etapes: (4 min) Attack, change of direction, then step-back or pull-up.
(3 min) Balanced stop despite the creating move.
(3 min) Shot loaded on balance.
x104.consignes: The change wins you space, the stop stays balanced, same mechanics.
x104.erreurs: The move breaks the balance of the shot.
x104.corrections: Work the stop first, the shot once your balance is steady.
x104.reussite: Steady shot after a real creating move.
x104.vEasy: No shot, just find the space.

x105.objectif: Hold your free-throw routine with something at stake.
x105.placement: In pairs or teams, at the free throw line.
etapes: (4 min) Each player shoots two free throws with his routine, keep count.
(3 min) The loser of the round does a short sprint, play again.
(3 min) Two decisive free throws called out, like at the end of a game.
x105.consignes: Same routine with something at stake, breathe before release, follow through with the wrist.
x105.corrections: Go back to your breathing and your routine, shot after shot.
x105.reussite: Routine held and free throws made despite the pressure.
x105.vEasy: Nothing at stake, aim for consistency.
x105.vHard: After a sprint, with a team score.

x106.objectif: Chain shots at a high pace across several spots.
x106.placement: Five spots around the arc, a passer, a rebounder.
etapes: (4 min) The shooter chains catch and shoot at each spot.
(4 min) One minute on the clock, count the makes.
(4 min) Rotate roles, compare scores.
x106.consignes: Hands ready before the ball, short but balanced stop, keep the pace without breaking your form.
x106.corrections: Lower the pace until the form is clean again.
x106.reussite: Target score reached with steady form.

x107.objectif: Finish with the hand opposite the drive side to fool the defender.
x107.placement: Start running toward the rim, a cone as the defender.
etapes: (3 min) Attack one side, finish with the opposite hand under the rim.
(3 min) High ball pickup, protect with the body.
(2 min) Alternate both sides.
x107.consignes: Go under the rim, protect the ball, finish with the hand away from the defender.
x107.erreurs: Finish on the defender's side, ball exposed.
x107.corrections: Make him go under the rim and finish with the protected hand.

x108.objectif: Choose the right finish when two defenders protect the rim.
x108.placement: A finisher, two teammates as passive help in the paint to start.
x108.materiel: 1 ball, two cones or two teammates
etapes: (4 min) Drive, read the space between the two passive helpers.
(3 min) Choose: floater over the top, reverse-foot finish, or kick-out, controlled contact near the rim.
(3 min) Alternate attack angles, live help only once the read is solid.
x108.consignes: Read the space early, pick the right finish, protect the ball. Passive help by default, no contesting the shot at full speed, controlled contact near the rim.
x108.erreurs: Charging in without reading, forced finish.
x108.corrections: Slow down at the edge of the paint to read both helpers.
x108.reussite: The chosen finish matches the space left.
x108.vHard: Live help that steps up to block, only once contact is controlled in the passive version.

x109.objectif: Finish strong at the rim off two feet to withstand contact.
x109.placement: Start running or dribbling toward the rim.
etapes: (3 min) Arrive, jump stop on two feet, ball protected.
(3 min) Strong finish with two hands or one firm hand.
(2 min) Alternate both sides.
x109.consignes: Two solid feet, ball close to the body, steady vertical jump.
x109.corrections: Demand the two-foot jump stop before the finish.

x110.titre: Pocket pass on the pick and roll
x110.objectif: Serve the roller with a low, protected pass in the short space.
x110.placement: A ball handler and a roller, a defender in drop.
etapes: (4 min) The ball handler attacks the screen, keeps his dribble alive.
(3 min) Low one-hand pass into the pocket, between the defender and the roller.
(3 min) The roller finishes at the rim.
x110.consignes: Keep your dribble, low and protected pass, time it to the roller's dive.
x110.erreurs: High pass that gets picked off, dribble killed too early.
x110.corrections: Lower the pass and keep the dribble until the window opens.
x110.reussite: The low pass finds the roller for a finish.
x110.vHard: Defense that clogs the passing lane.

x111.objectif: Bounce pass to slip past defensive arms.
x111.placement: One passer, one receiver at the rim, one or two defenders getting in the way.
etapes: (3 min) Bounce pass hitting two thirds of the way, under the arms.
(3 min) Pass timed with the receiver's cut.
(2 min) Alternate the angles.
x111.consignes: Firm pass, bounce at two thirds, under the defender's arms.
x111.erreurs: Pass too short or too soft, intercepted.
x111.corrections: Put the bounce at two thirds and add speed.
x111.reussite: The bounce pass reaches the receiver despite the pressure.
x111.vHard: Two defenders in the passing lanes.

x112.objectif: Loft a pass over the help for a roller running to the rim.
x112.placement: A ball handler and an athletic roller, one help defender sagging back.
etapes: (4 min) The ball handler attacks, the help sags back and leaves the lane to the rim.
(3 min) Soft lob pass over the help to the roller.
(3 min) Finish in the air or with a power layup.
x112.consignes: Aim in front of the roller toward the rim, soft arc, time it with the dive.
x112.erreurs: Lob too flat or too long.
x112.corrections: Soften the arc and aim at the space in front of the roller.
x112.reussite: The lob finds the roller for a finish above the rim.
x112.vHard: A help defender who contests the lob.

x113.objectif: Free a shooter with a down screen toward the perimeter.
x113.placement: A shooter down low, a screener above, a passer.
etapes: (4 min) The screener comes down to screen the shooter's defender.
(4 min) The shooter comes up tight off the screen toward the perimeter.
(4 min) Catch and shoot right away coming off.
x113.consignes: Screen set and still, the shooter rubs shoulders with it, hands ready coming off.
x113.corrections: Keep the exit tight to the screen and freeze the screener.
x113.reussite: The shooter comes off open, ready to shoot.

x114.objectif: Free a cut to the rim with a screen set behind the defender.
x114.placement: A cutter on the wing, a screener, a ball handler at the top of the key.
etapes: (4 min) The screener sets a screen on the cutter's defender from behind.
(4 min) The cutter goes hard to the rim, hands ready.
(4 min) Pass on the run, finish.
x114.consignes: Solid back screen, sharp cut, timed pass.
x114.erreurs: Screen given away too early, soft cut.
x114.corrections: Freeze the screen on contact and make the cut sharp.
x114.reussite: The cut gets free to the rim for a finish.

x115.titre: Flare screen for a perimeter shot
x115.objectif: Free a shooter who flares away from the ball behind a screen.
x115.placement: A ball handler at the top of the key, a shooter on the weak side, a screener.
etapes: (4 min) The screener screens the shooter's defender toward the outside.
(4 min) The shooter fades behind the screen, away from the ball.
(4 min) Lateral pass and shot coming off.
x115.consignes: Screen angled toward the outside, the shooter opens up, strong pass thrown early.
x115.erreurs: Soft pass that can be picked off, screen at the wrong angle.
x115.corrections: Angle the screen toward the outside and put zip on the pass.
x115.reussite: The shooter gets open for a ready perimeter shot.
x115.vHard: Defense going over the top of the screen.

x116.objectif: Free a shooter with two successive screens along the lane.
x116.placement: A shooter down low, two screeners lined up, a passer.
etapes: (5 min) The shooter comes up off the two screens in a row.
(4 min) He chooses to pop out high or curl short depending on the defense.
(4 min) Catch and shoot or finish.
x116.consignes: Rub off both screens, read the defender, come out the right side.
x116.erreurs: Robotic exit without reading the trailing defender.
x116.corrections: Have the shooter read where the trailing defender is before coming off.
x116.reussite: The shooter comes off open on the side the defense gives up.
x116.vHard: Defense that changes how it covers the screens.

x117.objectif: Create separation to receive with a V or L cut.
etapes: (4 min) V-cut, one step toward the rim then a sharp move back to the ball.
(4 min) L-cut along the paint to change the angle.
(2 min) Catch and go straight into an attack.
x117.consignes: Change speed and direction, show target hands, win the separation.
x117.erreurs: Soft cut with no change of speed.
x117.corrections: Demand a real burst on the move back to the ball.
x117.reussite: The receiver wins space and makes a clean catch.

x118.objectif: Occupy the right spaces when a teammate drives.
x118.placement: Four spaced offensive players, one ball handler driving.
etapes: (4 min) On the drive, the nearest players fill toward the open angles.
(4 min) The player above the ball cuts, the one below lifts.
(4 min) Pass to the open space, shot or finish.
x118.consignes: Move with the drive, keep your spacing, fill the space that opens up.
x118.erreurs: Players standing still, passing lanes clogged.
x118.corrections: Demand a move on every drive.
x118.reussite: The drive always finds a well-placed teammate.

x119.objectif: Drive to draw help then kick out to a spaced shooter.
x119.placement: One ball handler, three spaced shooters, a defense that helps.
etapes: (4 min) Hard drive to the rim to draw the help.
(4 min) Kick-out to the shooter the help left.
(4 min) Shot on the catch, or drive again if it's closed.
x119.consignes: Drive to draw the defense, keep your head up, kick out to the open player.
x119.erreurs: Driving head down without reading the help.
x119.corrections: Get your eyes up as you enter the paint.
x119.reussite: The drive creates an open shot off the kick-out.

x120.titre: Draw the help and serve the corner
x120.objectif: Draw the corner help then serve the open shooter.
