x120.placement: One ball handler, a corner shooter, a help defender coming from that side.
etapes: (4 min) Drive on the corner side to draw the low help.
(4 min) Pass to the open corner.
(4 min) The corner shoots right away, help is late.
x120.consignes: Attack the rim to draw the help, quick pass to the corner, immediate shot.
x120.erreurs: Late pass, the help gets back in time.
x120.corrections: Throw the pass as soon as the help commits.
x120.reussite: The corner shoots before the help recovers.
x120.vHard: Help defender who fakes to bait the pass.

x121.titre: Live one on one from triple threat
x121.objectif: Read the defender from triple threat and choose shot, drive or pass.
x121.placement: One offensive player in triple threat on the wing, one live defender.
etapes: (4 min) Read: if the defender backs off, the shot is open; if he closes in, the drive is open.
(3 min) Jab to confirm the read, then go.
(3 min) Switch roles every possession.
x121.consignes: Read before you act, the jab confirms, play what the defense gives you.
x121.erreurs: Move decided before reading the defender.
x121.corrections: Demand a read and a jab before any dribble.
x121.reussite: The choice matches the defender's reaction.

x122.titre: Two on two off a screen, live
x122.objectif: Chain screen, offensive read and defensive coverage in free play.
x122.placement: Two offensive players, two defenders, start off a screen.
etapes: (5 min) Free play starting from an on-ball screen.
(5 min) The defense picks its coverage, the offense responds.
(4 min) Rebound, then transition to the other end.
x122.consignes: Defensive talk on every screen, offensive read before the move.
x122.corrections: Demand a defensive call on every screen.
x122.reussite: Every possession starts from a real read on both sides.
x122.vHard: Score on stops instead of baskets.

x123.objectif: Play continuous three-man motion with pass, cut and screen.
x123.placement: Three on three, one team waiting.
etapes: (5 min) Every pass followed by a cut or a screen.
(5 min) A stop plus a rebound earns the ball and a bonus point.
(5 min) Teams rotate every two possessions.
x123.consignes: Pass and move, fill the spaces, talk on defense.
x123.erreurs: Static play, nonstop one on one.
x123.corrections: Demand an action after every pass.
x123.reussite: Baskets come out of team movement.

x124.objectif: Defend as a team in free play with help, closeout and rebound.
x124.placement: Four offensive players, four defenders, free play.
etapes: (6 min) On every pass, everyone adjusts one step toward the ball.
(5 min) Controlled closeout on shots, help on drives.
(5 min) Rebound then transition, count the stops.
x124.consignes: See your man and the ball, talk on every pass, help early, recover fast.
x124.erreurs: Defender locked on his man who loses sight of the ball.
x124.corrections: Demand a call on every pass.
x124.reussite: Every pass triggers a team adjustment.
x124.vHard: Free play with transition on the rebound.

x125.objectif: Transfer the skills into full play with one targeted rule.
etapes: (6 min) Offensive rule, for example at least three passes before a shot.
(6 min) Defensive rule, for example a mandatory call on every screen.
(6 min) Free play, note the moments when the rule paid off.
x125.consignes: The rule guides the game without freezing it, keep game intensity.
x125.erreurs: Rule forgotten as soon as the game speeds up.
x125.corrections: Stop play the first time it's forgotten and restate the rule.
x125.reussite: The rule holds at game speed.
x125.vHard: Two rules at once, shot clock on.

x126.objectif: Flow from the break into a quick set when the easy basket is closed.
x126.placement: Five offensive players in transition, five defenders getting back.
etapes: (5 min) Push the ball fast, look for the easy basket first.
(5 min) If it's closed, flow straight into a half-court action, screen or swing.
(4 min) Shoot in the flow, without resetting.
x126.consignes: Look for the easy basket fast, otherwise flow without stopping, keep the pace.
x126.erreurs: Play stops when the break is closed.
x126.corrections: Demand an immediate half-court action with no dead time.
x126.reussite: The fast break flows into a half-court action with no break.

x127.objectif: Run the big to the rim to gain the edge in transition.
x127.placement: A rebounder, a point guard, a big sprinting to the rim.
etapes: (4 min) Rebound, outlet, the big sprints straight to the rim.
(3 min) The point guard pushes the ball and hits the big ahead of the play.
(3 min) Finish before the defense gets back.
x127.consignes: The big runs without looking for the ball, the point guard leads him with the pass.
x127.erreurs: The big jogs up the floor, advantage lost.
x127.corrections: Demand a straight sprint to the rim off the rebound.
x127.reussite: The big catches ahead of the play for an easy finish.
x127.vHard: One transition defender on the big.

x128.objectif: Decide fast with a man up then defend the disadvantage in waves.
x128.placement: Four offensive players against three defenders, continuous waves.
etapes: (5 min) The four spread out, ball in the middle, find the open player.
(5 min) Basket or turnover, three go back the other way 3 on 2.
(4 min) Keep going with no dead time, rotate roles.
x128.consignes: The pass beats the run, punish the help, get back right away.
x128.erreurs: Individual play despite the extra player.
x128.corrections: Limit how long one player can hold the ball.
x128.reussite: The advantage is converted and the disadvantage is defended well.

x129.objectif: Anticipate the long rebounds of perimeter shots.
x129.placement: A three-point shooter, perimeter players ready for the long rebound.
etapes: (4 min) On a long shot the ball often comes off long, anticipate the area.
(3 min) Attack the long rebound at free throw line level.
(3 min) Push it out or take a second shot depending on the recovery.
x129.consignes: A long shot means a long rebound, stay high, attack the ball moving forward.
x129.erreurs: Staying under the rim on a perimeter shot.
x129.corrections: Move the perimeter players up into the long-rebound area.
x129.reussite: The long rebound is grabbed outside the paint.

x130.titre: Defensive rebound and outlet under pressure
x130.objectif: Secure the rebound then outlet despite immediate pressure.
x130.placement: A rebounder, an offensive player being boxed out, a defender pressuring the outlet.
etapes: (4 min) Box out, two-hand rebound, protect the ball.
(3 min) Pivot to the outside, away from the pressure.
(3 min) Strong outlet to an open teammate.
x130.consignes: Protect the rebound, pivot away from the pressure, firm outlet to the outside.
x130.erreurs: Ball exposed on the rebound, rushed outlet intercepted.
x130.corrections: Pivot toward the sideline first, secure the ball before passing.
x130.reussite: The rebound is secured and the outlet gets through despite the pressure.

x131.titre: Wave of tips at the rim
x131.objectif: Repeat tipping the ball at the rim with a firm wrist.
x131.placement: A line on the side of the rim, a ball thrown off the glass.
etapes: (3 min) One at a time, tip the ball toward the rim in one motion.
(3 min) If the tip misses, grab it and go back up balanced.
(2 min) Continuous wave, count the makes.
x131.consignes: Firm wrist, time your jump, if you grab it land balanced before going back up.
x131.corrections: Firm up the wrist and time the jump to the ball's path.
x131.reussite: Several made tips in a row.
x131.vEasy: Grab it, then go back up with a shot.
x131.vHard: One-hand tip off a moving board.

x132.objectif: Deny an inside player the catch by standing in front of him.
x132.placement: A big in the low post, a defender in front, a passer, weak-side help.
etapes: (4 min) The defender gets fully in front of the big.
(4 min) He holds the position, weak-side help protects against the lob.
(4 min) On a forced pass, steal or team recovery.
x132.consignes: In front of the big, active body, the help covers the lob, keep talking.
x132.erreurs: Fronting with no help, lob given up.
x132.corrections: Always make sure the weak-side help is there before fronting.
x132.reussite: The post entry is denied without giving up the lob.
x132.vEasy: No help, just set the position.
x132.vHard: Offense looking for the lob over the top.

x133.titre: Deny and recover on a flash
x133.objectif: Deny the catch of a player flashing to the high post.
x133.placement: A weak-side offensive player who flashes, a help defender, a ball handler.
etapes: (4 min) The defender sees his man and the ball, ready to deny the flash.
(3 min) On the flash, he steps up to contact and jumps the passing lane.
(3 min) If beaten, he opens toward the rim so he doesn't get blown by.
x133.consignes: See your man and the ball, step up to contact on the flash, deny the passing lane.
x133.erreurs: Clean catch on the flash, defender late.
x133.corrections: Anticipate the flash as soon as the ball changes sides.
x133.reussite: The flash is denied or caught under heavy pressure.

x134.objectif: Fake a help to slow the drive without leaving your shooter.
x134.placement: Three offensive players including two shooters, three defenders.
etapes: (5 min) On the drive, a shooter's defender makes a quick stunt toward the ball.
(5 min) He gets right back to his shooter before the pass.
(4 min) The deep help covers if the drive gets past the stunt.
x134.consignes: Short stunt toward the ball to slow it, get straight back to your shooter.
x134.erreurs: Stunt too long, shooter left open.
x134.corrections: Keep the stunt to one step and get back fast.
x134.reussite: The drive is slowed without giving up an open shot.
x134.vHard: Offense that makes the extra pass.

x135.objectif: Disrupt the pick-and-roll roller with a brief help before recovering.
x135.placement: A ball handler and a roller, a weak-side shooter, three defenders.
etapes: (5 min) On the roll, the weak-side defender briefly tags the roller.
(5 min) He gets back to his shooter before the kick-out.
(4 min) The big's defender recovers to his man as early as possible.
x135.consignes: Tag the roller to slow him, get back to your shooter fast, communicate.
x135.erreurs: Help held too long, shooter left open.
x135.corrections: Tag with one step and recover right away.
x135.reussite: The roller is slowed without giving up the perimeter shot.
x135.vHard: Offense that throws the skip to the shooter fast.
x135.stats: Points allowed on pick and roll

x136.objectif: Rotate in an X to cover two shooters after a help.
x136.placement: Three offensive players including two spaced shooters, three defenders.
etapes: (5 min) On the drive, the help comes from the weak side.
(5 min) On the kick-out, the two defenders rotate by crossing.
(4 min) Each one closes out on his shooter, never two on the same one.
x136.consignes: Rotate by crossing, each takes the right shooter, controlled closeout, keep talking.
x136.erreurs: Two defenders on the same shooter, one man open.
x136.corrections: Demand a clear cross and a call on every rotation.
x136.reussite: Both shooters are covered after the rotation.
x136.vHard: Offense that makes a second pass.

x137.objectif: Choose the right coverage of a down screen, over or under.
x137.placement: A shooter, a screener, two defenders.
etapes: (5 min) The shooter's defender trails over the screen to stay attached to a good shooter.
(4 min) The screener's defender helps briefly, then recovers.
(4 min) Alternate going over and under depending on the shooter.
x137.consignes: Stay attached to the shooter, go over against a good shooter, talk with the help.
x137.erreurs: Going under against an accurate shooter, shot given up.
x137.corrections: Against a good shooter, demand going over the top.
x137.reussite: The shooter is contested coming off the screen.
x137.vHard: Offense mixing high exits and cuts.

x138.titre: Defending the flare and the backdoor
x138.objectif: Deny both the flare screen and the cut behind the back.
x138.placement: A weak-side shooter, a screener, a ball handler, two defenders.
etapes: (5 min) The defender stays attached to deny the flare toward the outside.
(4 min) He opens toward the rim if the offensive player cuts backdoor.
(4 min) Talk with the screener's defender.
x138.consignes: Stay attached, see the ball, open up on the backdoor cut.
x138.erreurs: Getting screened on the flare or caught by the backdoor.
x138.corrections: Anticipate the screen and keep the ball in your field of vision.
x138.reussite: Neither the flare nor the backdoor frees the offensive player.

x139.objectif: Deny the passing lane without getting beaten backdoor.
x139.placement: A ball handler, a receiver, a defender denying.
etapes: (4 min) Firm denial, one hand in the lane, body partly open to the ball.
(3 min) On the backdoor cut, open toward the rim and close the lane.
(3 min) Back to denial if the offensive player comes back out.
x139.consignes: One hand in the lane, see the ball, open up on the cut so you don't get beaten.
x139.erreurs: Denying with eyes on your man only, backdoor given up.
x139.corrections: Keep the ball in your field of vision and anticipate the cut.
x139.reussite: The backdoor cut is shut down without giving up the catch.
x139.vHard: Receiver mixing V-cuts and backdoor cuts.

x140.titre: Defensive gap and closing the middle
x140.objectif: Sit in the gaps to close the middle of the floor.
x140.placement: Three offensive players, three defenders in help position.
etapes: (4 min) The off-ball defenders sit in the gap, one step toward the middle.
(4 min) Their presence slows any drive through the middle.
(4 min) Quick controlled closeout on the kick-out.
x140.consignes: One step into the gap, close the middle, controlled closeout on the pass.
x140.erreurs: Defenders glued to their man, middle open.
x140.corrections: Have the off-ball defenders drop one step toward the middle.
x140.reussite: The middle drive is shut down, shots stay contested.
x140.vHard: Offense attacking the middle with dribble drives.

x141.objectif: Crack a zone by linking the high post and the low post.
x141.placement: Five offensive players against a 2-3 zone, one player at the high post, one at the low post.
etapes: (5 min) Ball to the high post to freeze the back line of the zone.
(5 min) High-low pass to the low post behind the zone.
(4 min) Finish inside or kick out for a perimeter shot.
x141.consignes: Fill the high post, connect high and low, play fast behind the zone.
x141.erreurs: Attacking only around the zone, never inside.
x141.corrections: Demand a high post entry before running anything.
x141.reussite: The high-low connection opens a finish or a shot.

x142.objectif: Set a 1-3-1 zone that pressures the wings and the high post.
x142.placement: Five defenders in a 1-3-1, five offensive players moving the ball.
etapes: (5 min) The top defender steers the pass toward one wing.
(5 min) The wing and the high post trap, the back defender covers the low post and the corner.
(4 min) Slide on the ball reversal, recover fast.
x142.consignes: The top steers, trap the wing, the back covers behind, talk nonstop.
x142.erreurs: Corner and low post left open.
x142.corrections: Clearly assign the back defender to the corner and the low post.
x142.reussite: The zone bothers the wings without opening the back.
x142.vEasy: Slow ball movement to set the roles.
x142.vHard: Offense that hits the corners fast.

x143.objectif: Slow the opponent's advance with a soft press that traps at half court.
x143.placement: Five defenders in a 2-2-1 after a made basket, five offensive players inbounding.
etapes: (5 min) The first line steers the ball up toward one sideline.
(5 min) The second line traps toward half court, the back defender reads the long pass.
(5 min) Steal and immediate transition.
x143.consignes: Steer without getting beaten, trap at half court, the back defender anticipates the long pass.
x143.erreurs: Trap too early, leaving an easy pass behind it.
x143.corrections: Hold the trap until half court and set the back defender.
x143.reussite: The ball advance is slowed and often trapped at half court.

x144.objectif: Break a soft press by occupying the middle and the gaps.
x144.placement: Five offensive players against a 2-2-1, baseline inbound.
etapes: (5 min) A receiver in the middle breaks the first line.
(5 min) Advance through the middle, never along the sideline.
(5 min) Ball at half court, read the advantage and finish.
x144.consignes: One player always open in the middle, strong passes, ball through the middle.
x144.erreurs: Dribbling into the corners, passes along the sideline.
x144.corrections: Move the ball through the middle, not down the sideline.
x144.reussite: The press is broken and ends in an advantage.
x144.vEasy: Passive press that gives up the first pass.
x144.vHard: Eight-second clock to cross half court.

x145.objectif: Defend a three-point lead without giving up the three or the foul.
x145.placement: Five on five, up three, eight seconds on the clock.
etapes: (4 min) Take away the three, hands straight up, no foul on the shot.
(3 min) Give up a two rather than foul.
(3 min) Secure the rebound and end the possession.
x145.consignes: Contest without fouling, hands straight up, give up the two, get the rebound.
x145.erreurs: Fouling a three-point shooter, open three given up.
x145.corrections: Demand a vertical contest and no fouls on the shot.
x145.reussite: The lead holds with no three and no foul given up.
x145.vEasy: No clock, just set the principles.
x145.vHard: Very short clock and sideline inbound.

x146.objectif: Organize a last attack when one basket is enough to win.
x146.placement: Five on five, down one, fifteen seconds on the clock.
etapes: (4 min) Patient offense, hold the shot for the end of the clock.
(4 min) Clear first and second options, no early shot.
(4 min) Offensive rebound planned if the shot misses.
x146.consignes: Hold the shot until the end, two clear options, plan the offensive rebound.
x146.erreurs: Shot too early, leaving time for the opponent.
x146.corrections: Set the timing of the shot and the two options before the play.
x146.reussite: The game-winning shot goes up at the right moment with the rebound covered.
x146.vHard: Five seconds on a sideline inbound.

x147.objectif: Strengthen the back of the thigh to limit injuries on acceleration.
x147.placement: In pairs, one holds the ankles, or anchored to the floor.
x147.materiel: A partner or an anchor point
etapes: (3 min) Slow Nordic lowering, knees on the floor, ankles held, chest falling forward under control, 3 sets of 5 reps.
(3 min) Brake through the full range, push back up with the hands on the floor, 3 sets of 5, no jerking.
(2 min) Heel glute bridge, lift and hold 3 seconds, 2 sets of 8, hamstrings engaged.
x147.consignes: Slow, controlled lowering over three to five seconds, core braced, neutral back. No sharp pain in the back of the thigh. Key exercise against strains on acceleration. Progression: slow the lowering even more, use the hands less.
x147.erreurs: Dropping instead of lowering, back arching.
x147.corrections: Slow the lowering and keep the core braced.
x147.reussite: Controlled lowering through the full range.

x148.objectif: Strengthen ankle balance to prevent sprains.
x148.placement: Everyone standing on one foot, coach facing the group.
etapes: (3 min) Balance on one foot, 3 times 30 seconds per leg, eyes open then closed, knee slightly bent.
(3 min) Catch a pass while balancing on one foot, 3 sets of 8 per leg, stable after each catch.
(2 min) Small hops forward, back and sideways, land and hold one second on one foot, 3 sets of 6.
x148.consignes: Knee in line, active ankle, soft landing without wobbling. The foot grips the floor, toes grab. Progression: unstable surface, eyes closed, then a shooting motion while balancing. A priority when coming back from a sprain, pain-free.
x148.corrections: Fix the knee-foot alignment and soften the landing.
x148.reussite: Balance held and stable landings on one foot.
x148.vHard: On the pad, eyes closed, with the ball.

x149.titre: The animal forest, U7 motor skills
x149.objectif: Discover movement and handling by imitating animals.
x149.placement: A play area with markers, ball in hand.
etapes: (2 min) Story time: we cross the forest pretending to be animals.
(4 min) Frog jumps, bear walks, gazelle runs, holding the ball or dribbling.
(2 min) Cool down, put the balls away in the hoops.
x149.consignes: Have fun moving well, the youngest hold the ball, the others dribble.
x149.corrections: Space out the starts and give clear markers.
x149.reussite: The kids move, handle the ball and have fun safely.
x149.vEasy: No ball, just the animal moves.

x150.objectif: Discover accurate passing in a delivery game.
x150.placement: The kids in a circle, a mailman in the middle with the ball.
etapes: (2 min) Story time: the mailman delivers the mail, the ball.
(4 min) The mailman passes to a kid who passes it back, a different kid each time.
(2 min) Speed it up, everyone gets at least one delivery.
x150.consignes: Pass to your friend's hands, hands ready to catch, look at who you're passing to.
x150.erreurs: Pass too hard or thrown anywhere.
x150.corrections: Show the soft pass and looking at the receiver.
x150.reussite: The passes reach the hands, everyone got their mail.

x151.objectif: Keep a stable shooting motion when the legs get tired.
x151.placement: A shooter on the wing, a passer under the rim, a line of rebounders.
etapes: (4 min) Five baseline sprints, then catch and shoot from the wing.
(4 min) Chain shot, sprint back, shot from the opposite corner.
(4 min) Set of ten shots, score called out loud.
x151.consignes: Feet ready before the ball, shoulders square to the rim, same motion even when out of breath.
x151.erreurs: The shot gets shorter and comes from the belly as fatigue builds.
x151.corrections: Bend the legs on the catch, keep the elbow under the ball.
x151.reussite: At least seven of ten made at the end of the set.
x151.vEasy: One sprint only before each shot.
x151.vHard: A defender closes the shooting lane after the sprint.

x152.titre: Shot off a screen, shoulders ready
x152.objectif: Come off a screen ready to shoot with no prep time.
x152.placement: A shooter behind a cone acting as screener, a passer at the top of the key.
etapes: (4 min) Low exit off the screen, catch, shoot right away.
(4 min) Same exit with a defender trailing.
(4 min) Read: shoot if open, curl in if the defender goes under.
x152.consignes: Hide behind the screen, come off with shoulders facing the rim, shooting hand already ready.
x152.erreurs: Catching sideways, needing a dead moment to square up.
x152.corrections: Turn the inside foot toward the rim while running.
x152.reussite: The shot goes up in rhythm with the catch.
x152.vHard: Two screen options, the shooter chooses live.

x153.objectif: Strengthen the weak hand without looking at the ball.
x153.placement: Players spread out, two balls each, eyes on the coach.
etapes: (3 min) Alternating dribbles, weak hand lower.
(4 min) Weak hand dribbles hard, strong hand holds the ball up in the air.
(3 min) Defensive slides, weak hand leading.
x153.consignes: Fingertips, dribble below the hip, head up to read the visual signals.
x153.erreurs: The player looks down as soon as the weak hand works.
x153.corrections: Fix a marker on the wall, call out numbers to read during the drill.
x153.reussite: Thirty seconds of weak-hand dribbling without looking at the ball.
x153.vHard: Moving with required changes of direction.

x154.titre: Chain of tight changes at the cone
x154.objectif: Change hands fast and low at each cone, protecting the ball.
x154.placement: Four cones in a slalom, a line of dribblers.
etapes: (3 min) Crossover at each cone, shoulder dipping.
(4 min) Alternate crossover, between the legs, behind the back.
(3 min) Against the clock, two timed runs.
x154.consignes: Low dribble on the change, shoulder past the cone, explode out of it.
x154.erreurs: High, slow change, ball left exposed.
x154.corrections: Bend the knees, change below cone height.
x154.reussite: Clean slalom under the target time, no lost ball.
x154.vHard: A passive defender touches the ball if it's exposed.

x155.titre: Pass into the run in transition
x155.objectif: Serve a running teammate without breaking his stride.
x155.placement: Three players in three lanes, starting from the baseline.
etapes: (3 min) Push the ball up three-wide, passes in front of the teammate.
(4 min) Add a transition defender, read the open pass.
(3 min) Must finish in fewer than three passes.
x155.consignes: Pass in front of the runner's chest, in his stride, never at his feet.
x155.erreurs: Late pass that kills the receiver's speed.
x155.corrections: Anticipate, aim at the space in front of him, not at the player.
x155.reussite: The lane ends with a layup without breaking stride.

x156.objectif: Exploit the advantage before the opponent gets back.
x156.placement: Three offensive players, two defenders already back.
etapes: (5 min) Attack the advantage, shot in under four seconds.
(5 min) The first defender picks the ball or the point guard.
(4 min) The third offensive player gets open on the opposite wing.
x156.consignes: Attack the rim to draw the defense, hit the open player, shoot in rhythm.
x156.erreurs: The ball handler stops and lets the defense get set.
x156.corrections: Keep the speed, decide before the free throw line.
x156.reussite: Open shot before the defense evens the numbers.
x156.vHard: A third defender sprints back to even the numbers.

x157.objectif: Protect the rim first, the ball second.
x157.placement: Four on offense, two defenders starting late.
etapes: (4 min) Sprint back, first defender under the rim.
(4 min) Second defender stops the ball at half court.
(4 min) Communication: who takes the ball, who protects the middle.
x157.consignes: Run to your rim, talk, protect the middle before stepping out to the ball.
x157.erreurs: Everyone follows their man, the middle stays open.
x157.corrections: First one back protects the basket, second slows the ball handler.
x157.reussite: No easy finish in the middle over the series.
x157.vEasy: One offensive player only on the break.
x157.vHard: Five on offense against three back.

x158.titre: Contain the handler, without dropping too far
x158.objectif: Contain the drive without getting beaten or fouling.
x158.placement: A ball handler at the top of the key, a defender in a low stance.
etapes: (3 min) Lateral slides, keep the ball in front of you.
(4 min) The ball handler attacks a shoulder, the defender cuts off the line.
(3 min) Three dribbles to score, the defender contains.
x158.consignes: Staggered stance, low hand on the ball side, push him toward the sideline.
x158.erreurs: The defender backs up in a straight line and gets beaten.
x158.corrections: Stay a shoulder ahead, steer him toward the help.
x158.reussite: Ball handler pushed toward the sideline without a foul.
x158.vHard: The ball handler can go either way.

x159.titre: Help and recover on a drive
x159.objectif: Help on the ball then recover to your man in time.
x159.placement: Two offensive players, two defenders, a marked strong side.
etapes: (5 min) The ball handler drives, the help steps in to stop the ball.
(5 min) Pass to the open player, the help recovers with slides.
(4 min) Full rotation if a second pass goes out.
x159.consignes: Help with one foot in the paint, recover as soon as the pass goes out.
x159.erreurs: The help stays stuck and leaves the shooter.
x159.corrections: Short help, eyes on the ball and on your man.
x159.reussite: Drive stopped and shooter recovered before the shot.
x159.vHard: Three offensive players moving the ball.

x160.titre: Pick and roll, reading the big defender
x160.objectif: Read the screen defender's position to decide.
x160.placement: A ball handler, a screener, and their two defenders.
etapes: (5 min) High screen, read whether the big steps up or drops.
(5 min) Big drops: ball handler shoots. Big steps up: roll.
(5 min) Add a help defender, pass to the right player.
x160.consignes: Come tight off the screen, read the big, shoot on the drop, hit the roller on a hard hedge.
x160.erreurs: Decision made before reading, wrong option chosen.
x160.corrections: Slow down a split second, read the big defender's hips.
x160.reussite: The right option chosen for the coverage.
x160.vHard: Aggressive hard hedge and back-line help.

x161.titre: Backdoor cut on a defender playing too high
x161.objectif: Punish the defender who overprotects the passing lane.
x161.placement: A ball handler at the top, an overplayed wing, a passer.
etapes: (3 min) Call for the ball, then backdoor cut behind the defender.
(4 min) Lob pass or bounce pass depending on where the help is.
(3 min) Two-step finish on the rim side.
x161.consignes: Fake the call, explode backdoor as soon as the defender jumps up.
x161.erreurs: Cut too early, the passer isn't ready.
x161.corrections: Sync the passer's eyes with the start of the cut.
x161.reussite: Ball caught behind the defense for an easy finish.
x161.vEasy: Passive defender playing high on purpose.
x161.vHard: Weak-side help coming over to close.

x162.objectif: Set a ball screen then make yourself available.
x162.placement: Two perimeter players, a big as screener, a passer.
etapes: (4 min) Set the screen, then dive to the ball or pop open.
(4 min) Read: roll or pop depending on the defense.
(4 min) Two screens in a row, strong side then weak side.
x162.consignes: After the screen, don't stand and watch: dive or open the passing angle.
x162.erreurs: The screener watches the play instead of repositioning.
x162.corrections: One beat for the screen, one beat to get open.
x162.reussite: The screener becomes a passing option again on every sequence.

x163.titre: One on one, back to the basket
x163.objectif: Score near the rim by reading the defender at your back.
x163.placement: An attacker in the low post, a defender behind, a passer.
etapes: (4 min) Catch in the low post, feel the defender's weight.
(4 min) Drop step to the open side, or back to the middle.
(4 min) Add late help, read again.
x163.consignes: Feel the defender with your elbow, attack the side he gives you.
x163.erreurs: The attacker dribbles too much and loses position.
x163.corrections: One or two dribbles max, decide on contact.
x163.reussite: Finish close to the rim with no offensive foul.

x164.titre: Fast swing for an open shot
x164.objectif: Move the ball faster than the defense can slide.
x164.placement: Four attackers around the arc, two relay passers.
etapes: (4 min) Swing the ball side to side in two passes.
(4 min) Open shot as soon as the defense is late.
(4 min) Draw the defender then swing, extra pass to the corner.
x164.consignes: Quick, long passes, don't hold the ball, punish late help.
x164.erreurs: One pass too many, the defense catches up on the slide.
x164.corrections: Shoot as soon as it opens, one extra pass is enough.
x164.reussite: Open shot after a full swing.

x165.objectif: Win the position and finish on the second rebound.
x165.placement: Two attackers, two defenders boxing out.
etapes: (3 min) Get around the box out on the short side.
(4 min) Grab it and put it right back up strong.
(3 min) Controlled tip if the ball is high.
x165.consignes: Read the flight of the ball, get around the box out, put it back up strong and high.
x165.erreurs: The attacker pushes in the back and fouls.
x165.corrections: Go around the side, play the ball, not the contact.
x165.reussite: Second-chance rebound won and putback scored.
x165.vEasy: No box out from the defense.

x166.objectif: Lock up the rebound then start the transition.
x166.placement: Two attackers, two defenders, shot triggered by the coach.
etapes: (3 min) Contact, pivot, box out the attacker.
(4 min) Two-hand catch, then first pass to the sideline lane.
(3 min) Rebound into a long outlet in one go.
x166.consignes: Find a body, pivot, grab it high, outlet fast to the wing.
x166.erreurs: The defender watches the ball and forgets the contact.
x166.corrections: Hit your man first, then go get the ball.
x166.reussite: Rebound secured and first outlet pass completed.

x167.objectif: Force a turnover right off the inbound.
x167.placement: Full-court defense, offense inbounding from the baseline.
etapes: (5 min) Deny the first pass, push it toward the sideline.
(5 min) Trap in the corner after the inbound.
(5 min) Steal or held ball, rotate behind.
x167.consignes: Close the middle, push to the sideline, trap in the corner.
x167.erreurs: The trap leaves the middle open.
x167.corrections: The third defender reads the outlet pass.
x167.reussite: Ball stolen or tied up before half court.
x167.vHard: Offense trained to break the press.

x168.titre: Break the press through the middle
x168.objectif: Cross the press by finding the middle player.
x168.placement: Five attackers in a press-break set, defense pressing.
etapes: (5 min) Quick inbound, look for the middle man.
(5 min) The middle man turns to face the floor and hits the sideline lane.
(4 min) Finish with the numbers advantage at the other end.
x168.consignes: Stay calm, fill the middle, turn and face, play forward.
x168.erreurs: The ball handler dribbles into the trap instead of passing.
x168.corrections: Pass before you dribble, look for the middle man.
x168.reussite: Press broken with no turnover, basket with the numbers advantage.

x169.objectif: Avoid the last defender's contact with an offset two-step.
x169.placement: One line, a cone as the help defender at the edge of the paint.
etapes: (3 min) Pick up the ball on the run, first step wide.
(4 min) Second step offset to the other side of the cone.
(3 min) Finish with the protected hand, away from the contact.
x169.consignes: Gather on one beat, first step wide, second step sideways.
x169.erreurs: Travel: the gather and the steps aren't in sync.
x169.corrections: Count one-two out loud, ball gathered before the first step.
x169.reussite: Two legal steps and a finish away from the help.

x170.objectif: Finish from mid-range over a tall defender.
x170.placement: One line, a tall cone standing in for the opposing big.
etapes: (3 min) One dribble, one-foot takeoff, soft high arc.
(4 min) Floater with either hand depending on the side.
(3 min) Read: floater if the help steps up, layup if not.
x170.consignes: Take off early, load high in front of your forehead, soft touch off the glass or the rim.
x170.erreurs: Floater released too close, blocked by the big.
x170.reussite: Ball drops into the rim over the help.

x171.objectif: Strengthen the trunk and footwork quality for changes of direction.
x171.placement: Players spread out, on mats or the court, guided self-work.
etapes: (4 min) Front plank then side plank, 30 seconds each position, 2 rounds, hips locked, no arched back.
(4 min) Jump lunges landing stable in a defensive stance, 3 sets of 8, knee in line.
(4 min) Short forward and lateral bounds, quiet landings, 3 sets of 8, one second of stability between each.
x171.consignes: Core braced the whole time, land with bent knees and no noise, feet and knees in line. This is the base of every change of direction. Progression: hold the planks longer, then chain lunges and bounds with no rest once the landings stay clean.
x171.erreurs: Landing on straight legs, knees caving in.
x171.corrections: Absorb on both feet, knees in line with the toes.
x171.reussite: Stable, quiet landings through the whole set.
x171.vEasy: No jumps, feet on the floor.
x171.vHard: Chain the blocks with no rest.

x172.objectif: Fine-tune the slides and rotations with four.
x172.placement: Four attackers around the arc, four defenders lined up.
etapes: (5 min) Adjust on every pass, help position.
(6 min) Drive, help and full rotation behind.
(5 min) Live play, two dribbles max per attacker.
x172.consignes: One step toward the ball on every pass, help and rotate, never stop talking.
x172.erreurs: Late rotation, a shooter left alone in the corner.
x172.corrections: Anticipate the pass, the rotation starts from the weak side.
x172.reussite: No open shot given up over a full sequence.
x172.vEasy: Offense limited to two dribbles, no screens.
x172.vHard: Offense with screens and free cuts.

x173.objectif: Protect the paint and contest shots without tearing apart.
x173.placement: Five defenders in a 2-3, offense moving the ball.
etapes: (5 min) Slide by lines depending on where the ball is.
(5 min) Close the middle and the high post.
(5 min) Contested closeout on the shooter, then back into the zone.
x173.consignes: Move as one, close the middle, contest and get back to your area.
x173.erreurs: Two defenders closing out on the same player.
x173.corrections: Clear area responsibilities, talk on every pass.
x173.reussite: Inside shut down, outside shots contested.
x173.vHard: Fast offense with a player at the high post.

x174.titre: Attacking the zone through the high post
x174.objectif: Open the zone by playing the ball inside at the foul line.
x174.placement: Five attackers in a 1-3-1 against a zone.
etapes: (5 min) Pass to the high post, read both wings.
(5 min) Quick swing to shift the zone.
(4 min) Cut into the gap left by the slide.
x174.consignes: Find the high post, play fast side to side, cut into the gaps.
x174.erreurs: Ball moving too slowly around the zone.
x174.corrections: Attack the gaps, get the ball into the middle.
x174.reussite: Inside shot or open shot found in a gap.
x174.vHard: Zone that slides fast and contests.

x175.titre: Inbound under the basket, lob option
x175.objectif: Create an easy shot on a baseline inbound.
x175.placement: Four attackers in a box, an inbounder under the basket.
etapes: (4 min) Cross screens in the box to free a cutter.
(4 min) Lob option if the post defender follows too far.
(4 min) Second option, corner shot if the lob is covered.
x175.consignes: Solid screen, cutter's timing, high lob toward the glass if the help is missing.
x175.erreurs: Rushed inbound before the screens are set.
x175.corrections: Wait for the signal, respect the order of the screens.
x175.reussite: Open shot or lob converted within five seconds.

x176.objectif: Build a good shot in the final seconds.
x176.placement: Five on five, clock started at eight seconds.
etapes: (5 min) Ball screen for the best creator.
(5 min) Read: shot, drive, or pass to the open shooter.
(4 min) Offensive rebound planned if the shot misses.
x176.consignes: Keep your dribble, use the screen late, shoot or hit the corner at two seconds.
x176.erreurs: Shot rushed at six seconds, no second effort planned.
x176.corrections: Use the screen around four seconds, crash the glass.
x176.reussite: Good shot taken at the right moment with a rebounder in support.

x177.titre: Two on two with screen and read
x177.objectif: Decide fast with two according to the defensive coverage.
x177.placement: Two attackers, two defenders, ball screen action.
etapes: (5 min) Screen, read pass or shot depending on the defense.
(5 min) Defense switches, attack the size mismatch.
(4 min) Defense goes under, punish with the shot.
x177.consignes: Read the coverage, play the mismatch, never force a covered option.
x177.erreurs: Decision locked in ahead of time without reading the defense.
x177.corrections: Look at both defenders' hips before choosing.
x177.reussite: The option chosen matches the actual coverage.

x178.objectif: Chain offense and defense with no mental let-up.
x178.placement: Three on three, the team that loses the ball defends right away.
etapes: (6 min) Continuous play, change on a basket or a stop.
(5 min) Two passes minimum before finishing.
(5 min) Bonus for a converted offensive rebound.
x178.consignes: Keep going without a breather, talk on defense, play fast on offense.
x178.erreurs: Letting up in the switch from offense to defense.
x178.corrections: Sprint back, start talking the moment the ball is lost.
x178.reussite: Intensity held through the whole sequence, few easy shots given up.
x178.vHard: Three passes and a required rebound.

x179.titre: Reading the closeout, drive or shoot
x179.objectif: Choose shot or drive according to the defender's closeout.
x179.placement: A shooter in the corner, a defender closing out, a passer.
etapes: (3 min) Short closeout: shoot right away.
(4 min) Long, off-balance closeout: one dribble and finish.
(3 min) Free read, the passer varies the timing.
x179.consignes: Shoulders ready, shoot if the defender is far, attack his high foot if he's flying at you.
x179.erreurs: Forced shot while the defender is coming in at full speed.
x179.corrections: Read the last step, drive to the off-balance side.
x179.reussite: The right option chosen for the speed of the closeout.

x180.objectif: Finish cleanly on both sides of the rim with the right hand.
x180.placement: Two lines, one on each side of the basket.
etapes: (3 min) Right-hand layup on the right side, off the left foot.
(4 min) Left-hand layup on the left side, off the right foot.
(3 min) Alternate both sides continuously.
x180.consignes: Outside hand, drive the free knee up, soft lay-in off the glass.
x180.erreurs: Finishing right-handed on the left side, ball exposed to the block.
x180.corrections: Demand the outside hand on each side.
x180.reussite: Ten finishes in a row made with both hands.
x180.vEasy: No dribble, start under the rim.

x181.objectif: Discover the ball while having fun and listen to the coach's signal.
x181.placement: Each child in a hoop, their home, ball in their hands.
etapes: (3 min) The rabbits roll the ball around their home, to the right then to the left.
(4 min) On the signal, the rabbits go out for a walk holding the ball, on the next signal they hurry back home.
(3 min) Take away one home, the rabbit with no home joins a friend, everyone laughs, start again.
x181.consignes: Tell it as a story, show the move, praise every child. The ball stays a toy, no scolding if it falls.
x181.erreurs: The child hugs the ball tight and won't let go.
x181.corrections: Show holding it with two hands in front, offer to roll it, never force it.
x181.reussite: The child goes out and comes back on the right signal, keeping the ball.
x181.vEasy: No ball at first, just the homes.
x181.vHard: Go back home bouncing the ball once.

x182.objectif: Learn to dribble and to stop by playing with colors.
x182.placement: Children in a line, ball in hand, coach in front with the colors.
x182.materiel: 1 ball per child, 3 cards: red, orange, green
etapes: (3 min) Green, move forward bouncing the ball. Red, stop and hold the ball.
(4 min) Add orange: dribble in place, nice and slow.
(3 min) The first to reach the other side without mixing up a color wins, play again.
x182.consignes: Hold the color up high, make it big, sing the colors. The bounce doesn't have to be perfect, the stop is what counts.
x182.erreurs: The child looks at the ball and misses the color.
x182.corrections: Ask them to look at you, stand right in front, slow the game down.
x182.reussite: The child stops on red and goes again on green.
x182.vEasy: Walk with the ball in your hands, no dribble.

x183.objectif: Move, run and handle the ball in a gathering game.
x183.placement: Balls scattered on the floor in the middle, two teams, each with its own bin.
x183.materiel: Lots of balls, 2 bins or hoops
etapes: (3 min) On the signal, each child grabs a ball and brings it back to their team's bin.
(4 min) Only one ball at a time, bring it back, go again.
(3 min) Count the balls together, clap for both teams.
x183.consignes: Focus on the fun of running and bringing balls back, not on winning. Everybody wins.
x183.erreurs: The child grabs several balls at once and drops them.
x183.corrections: Repeat the rule, one ball at a time, show it by doing it with them.
x183.reussite: The child brings the balls back and goes there and back each time.
x183.vEasy: Carry the ball in your arms.
x183.vHard: Bring the ball back bouncing it.

x184.objectif: Control the low dribble, like a little dog on a leash.
x184.placement: Children spread out, each with a ball, their dog.
etapes: (3 min) Walk your dog by bouncing it low next to you, walking slowly.
(4 min) Don't let the dog run away, keep the ball close to you.
(3 min) On the signal, the dog sits, catch the ball and hold it.
x184.consignes: Low dribble, soft hand, pat the dog. Lots of reassuring words, the child gets attached to the ball.
x184.erreurs: The child hits too hard and the ball rolls far away.
x184.corrections: Show the soft touch, lower, like petting.
x184.reussite: The ball stays close to the child during the walk.
x184.vEasy: Dribble in place, the dog stays at your feet.

x185.objectif: Dribble on the move and keep your head up to avoid the wolf.
x185.placement: Children dribble inside an area, an adult or a child is the wolf.
x185.materiel: 1 ball per child, a pinnie for the wolf
etapes: (3 min) The children walk their ball through the forest, bouncing it.
(4 min) When the wolf comes close, move away keeping your ball, head up.
(3 min) Tagged? You become the wolf, everyone laughs, keep playing.
x185.consignes: The wolf plays gently, scary just for fun. Praise the ones who keep their head up.
x185.erreurs: The child stares at the ball and gets caught.
x185.corrections: Ask them to look at the wolf, slow down, reassure.
x185.reussite: The child moves while dribbling and still looks around.
x185.vEasy: Run away holding the ball in your arms.

x186.objectif: Dribble while the music plays, freeze when it stops.
x186.placement: Children spread out with their ball, music playing.
etapes: (3 min) The music plays, dribble while walking everywhere.
(4 min) The music stops, become a statue and hold the ball.
(3 min) The best statue is shown to everyone, start again.
x186.consignes: Stop the music sharply. Cheer the funny statues, not only the perfect ones.
x186.erreurs: The child keeps moving after the music stops.
x186.corrections: Be a statue yourself, act out freezing big.
x186.reussite: The child freezes at the right time and keeps the ball.
x186.vEasy: Walk holding the ball, no dribble.

x187.objectif: Discover the two-hand pass to a friend, up close.
x187.placement: Children in pairs, face to face, two small steps apart.
etapes: (3 min) Hold the ball with two hands in front of your chest and push it to your friend.
(4 min) Your friend catches with open hands, then sends it back.
(3 min) Count the passes together out loud, celebrate the record.
x187.consignes: Stand close at first, push with two hands, open hands to catch. Clap for every catch.
x187.erreurs: The child throws the ball up in the air or too hard.
x187.corrections: Show the push straight ahead, move the friends closer.
x187.reussite: The ball goes from one child to the other and gets caught.
x187.vEasy: Hand the ball over without throwing it.
x187.vHard: Take one step back after each good pass.

x188.objectif: Discover shooting by aiming at a wide, easy target.
x188.placement: Children in a line right next to a low basket or a big bin.
x188.materiel: 1 ball per child, a low basket or a big bin
etapes: (4 min) Push the ball with both hands toward the castle to score.
(4 min) Take one tiny step back when it goes in.
(4 min) Everyone counts their balls in the castle, cheer for everyone.
x188.consignes: Big, low target, so they score right away at first. Push up, legs help. Lots of cheering.
x188.erreurs: The child throws one-handed from the side.
x188.corrections: Show both hands going up, move the target closer.
x188.reussite: The ball reaches the castle and the child is proud.
x188.vEasy: Put the ball in the bin.
x188.vHard: Basket a little higher or one step farther.

x189.objectif: Cooperate and pass the ball along, discovering the group.
x189.placement: Children standing in a line, legs apart, making a tunnel.
etapes: (3 min) Roll the ball through the tunnel from one end to the other.
(4 min) The last child catches the ball, runs to the front and starts the tunnel again.
(3 min) Pass the ball hand to hand over your heads.
x189.consignes: A teamwork game, nobody loses. Cheer helping each other and laughing.
x189.erreurs: The ball rolls out the sides of the tunnel.
x189.corrections: Move the children closer, show how to guide the ball.
x189.reussite: The ball goes all the way through the tunnel without rolling out.
x189.vEasy: Pass the ball hand to hand sitting down.
x189.vHard: Switch between the tunnel on the floor and passing over the head.

x190.objectif: Move forward dribbling and freeze, like red light green light.
x190.placement: Children on a starting line, coach facing them at the far end.
etapes: (3 min) The coach says one, two, three, basket and turns around, the children move forward dribbling.
(4 min) When the coach turns back, everyone becomes a statue with their ball.
(3 min) The first one to the end pushes the ball into the basket, everyone claps.
x190.consignes: Red light, green light with a ball. Laugh, nobody gets sent back to the start, cheer them on to freeze.
x190.erreurs: The child is still moving when the coach looks.
x190.corrections: Turn around more slowly, give them time to stop.
x190.reussite: The child moves forward dribbling and freezes in time.
x190.vHard: Freeze in a low stance, ready to go again.

x191.objectif: Carry the ball and pass it, like a mailman making a delivery.
x191.placement: Children in pairs, a hoop house at each end.
etapes: (3 min) The mailman carries the ball to his friend and puts it in their hands.
(4 min) Pass the ball with two hands for the last few steps, don't carry it.
(3 min) Count the letters delivered, cheer the mailmen.
x191.consignes: Link moving and passing. Always kind words, we deliver to help our friend.
x191.erreurs: The child keeps the ball and forgets to give it.
x191.corrections: Remind them to deliver, show giving it with two hands.
x191.reussite: The ball is delivered to the friend and caught.
x191.vEasy: Hand the ball over, no pass.
x191.vHard: Deliver while bouncing the ball once.

x192.objectif: Cross while dribbling and avoid the crocodiles, having fun.
x192.placement: A river between two lines, one or two crocodiles in the middle.
x192.materiel: 1 ball per child, two lines or ropes
etapes: (4 min) The children cross the river bouncing their ball.
(4 min) The crocodiles walk in the middle, avoid them and keep your ball.
(4 min) Tagged? You become a nice crocodile, everyone plays again together.
x192.consignes: The crocodiles play gently. Praise the courage to cross and the dribble, not speed.
x192.erreurs: The child drops the ball to run faster.
x192.corrections: Remind them to keep their ball, slow the game down, reassure.
x192.reussite: The child crosses the river and keeps dribbling.
x192.vEasy: Cross holding the ball in your arms.

x193.objectif: Rebuild the aerobic base, the foundation that delays fatigue and protects against injury on return.
x193.placement: As a group, on a regular route or around the court, free but steady pace.
x193.materiel: None, a route or the court
etapes: (5 min) Brisk walk then gradually into a jog, deep breathing.
(12 min) Continuous run at conversation pace, you should be able to talk while running.
(3 min) Back to a jog then a walk, slow breathing.
x193.consignes: Low, steady pace, the goal is duration, not speed. This is the first block to set up when returning, before any intense work.
x193.erreurs: Starting too fast and ending up stopped.
x193.corrections: Demand conversation pace, slow down rather than speed up.
x193.reussite: Run the twelve minutes without stopping, at the same pace.
x193.vEasy: Alternate two minutes running and one walking.
x193.vHard: Extend to fifteen, then twenty minutes of continuous running.

x194.objectif: Reintroduce intensity through intervals, close to the stop-start efforts of a game.
x194.placement: Over a distance of twenty to thirty meters, start on a line, there and back.
etapes: (4 min) Progressive warm-up, running drills and easy accelerations.
(9 min) Eight to ten reps of 30 seconds fast running followed by 30 seconds walking.
(3 min) Cool-down, light jog then walk.
x194.consignes: Hard but controlled effort for the 30 seconds, real recovery walking. Bring this block in after one to two weeks of aerobic base.
x194.erreurs: Sprinting all out on the first rep and falling apart.
x194.corrections: Aim for an intensity you can hold on every rep, steady from start to finish.
x194.reussite: Cover the same distance on every 30-second effort.
x194.vEasy: Six reps, 30 seconds of effort for 45 of recovery.
x194.vHard: Go to twelve reps or 40 seconds of effort.

x195.objectif: Strengthen the back of the thigh eccentrically, the best documented measure against hamstring strains.
x195.placement: Kneeling, ankles held by a partner, torso upright.
x195.materiel: A partner or an ankle anchor
etapes: (3 min) Hamstring warm-up, high knees, butt kicks, leg swings.
(6 min) Nordic lowers, the torso falls forward braking as hard as possible, push back up with the hands, 3 sets of 5.
(3 min) Gentle hamstring stretch and breathing.
x195.consignes: Brake as far down as possible, the lowering takes three to five seconds. Heavy load on the muscles: start with two sessions a week, never the day before a game.
x195.erreurs: Bending at the waist instead of keeping the body in line.
x195.corrections: Stay braced from knees to shoulders, the whole body falls as one block.
x195.reussite: Control the lowering over a range that grows week by week.
x195.vEasy: Reduced range with a lot of help from the hands.
x195.vHard: Very slow lowering with no help on the last few degrees.

x196.objectif: Strengthen the adductors to protect the groin and pelvis, heavily loaded by defensive slides.
x196.placement: In a side plank, top leg resting on a bench or held by a partner.
x196.materiel: A bench or a partner's help
etapes: (3 min) Set-up and warm-up, side plank with bent knee.
(6 min) Copenhagen: raise the hips by pushing through the top leg, 3 sets of 6 to 8 per side.
(3 min) Hip mobility and light adductor stretch.
x196.consignes: Body in line, hips rise without arching the back. Start with the knee bent, straight leg only once the movement is clean.
x196.corrections: Reduce the range, go back to the bent knee, brace the core.
x196.reussite: Hold the hips high and in line through the whole set.
x196.vHard: Straight leg on the bench, longer holds.

x197.objectif: Reacclimate the body to jumps and landings in stages, from bodyweight to a height.
x197.placement: Clear space, a low, solid box.
x197.materiel: A low box or a stable step
etapes: (4 min) Footwork warm-up, high knees, small hops, ankle mobility.
(5 min) Two-foot jumps on the floor, soft and quiet landings, 4 sets of 6.
(6 min) Jumps onto a low box then controlled step down, stable landing, 4 sets of 6.
x197.consignes: The jump isn't the point, the landing is. Quiet, knees in line, a moment of stability before the next one. Only raise the height when the landing stays perfect.
x197.erreurs: Noisy landing, knees caving in, going for height too fast.
x197.corrections: Lower the height, land on the balls of the feet, hold one second on landing.
x197.vHard: Floor jump straight into an immediate rebound onto the box.

x198.objectif: Strengthen each leg separately, the single-leg strength that protects knees and ankles on return.
x198.placement: Standing with your back to the bench, one foot resting behind on the bench.
etapes: (3 min) Warm-up, bodyweight squats, hip mobility.
(6 min) Bulgarian split squats, controlled lowering of the knee toward the floor, 3 sets of 8 per leg.
(3 min) Quad and hip flexor stretch.
x198.consignes: Knee in line with the foot, stable torso, slow lowering. The back leg balances, all the work is on the front leg.
x198.erreurs: Knee caving in or going way past the toes.
x198.corrections: Move the front foot slightly forward, slow the lowering.
x198.reussite: Eight clean reps per leg with no loss of balance.
x198.vEasy: Reduced range, one hand for support.
x198.vHard: Very slow lowering or a pause at the bottom of each rep.

x199.objectif: Strengthen calves and Achilles tendon to absorb landings and protect the ankle.
x199.placement: Standing on a step, heels hanging off, one hand for support.
etapes: (3 min) Warm-up, slow calf raises on both feet.
(5 min) Slow heel drops below the level of the step, 3 sets of 10, assisted back up if needed.
(2 min) Gentle calf stretch against a wall.
x199.consignes: The lowering is the key, slow and controlled over three to four seconds. Full range, no pain in the tendon.
x199.erreurs: Fast lowering that bounces at the bottom.
x199.corrections: Brake all the way down, feel the calf working on the way down.
x199.reussite: Thirty slow drops with no jerks and no pain.
x199.vHard: On one leg, very slow lowering.

x200.objectif: Develop sport-specific endurance through rising speed levels, like the field tests of physical trainers.
x200.placement: Two lines twenty meters apart, players run there and back on a signal.
x200.materiel: Two cones twenty meters apart, an audio signal
etapes: (4 min) Progressive warm-up, running drills and easy accelerations.
(8 min) Twenty-meter shuttles to the beat of a signal, the pace rises by levels, everyone holds on as long as possible.
(2 min) Cool-down, very light jog then walk.
x200.consignes: Touch the line on every signal, brake and push off on solid feet. Use this at the end of the return phase, once the aerobic base and the intervals are in place.
x200.erreurs: Starting too fast and dropping out in the first levels.
x200.corrections: Stay just on the beat at the start, keep something in reserve.
x200.reussite: Keep up with the beat over several levels with sharp footwork.
x200.vHard: Add dribbling a ball during the shuttle.

x201.objectif: Maintain the aerobic base and aid recovery through moderate, steady-paced running.
x201.placement: On the court or a route, running blocks broken up by walking.
x201.materiel: None, the court or a route
etapes: (4 min) Warm-up, gradual jog.
(10 min) Tempo run at moderate pace, about seventy to seventy-five percent, in blocks of two to three minutes with a short walk between each.
(2 min) Cool-down, walking and breathing.
x201.consignes: Steady but comfortable pace, never a sprint. Ideal at the start of the return and as an active recovery session between two hard days.
x201.erreurs: Turning the tempo into a fast run.
x201.corrections: Keep a pace where you can breathe through your nose, steady.
x201.reussite: Hold the same pace on every block without speeding up or slowing down.
x201.vHard: Three- to four-minute blocks, shorter walks.

x202.objectif: Build a trunk that resists rotation, which stabilizes shots and footwork and protects the back.
x202.placement: Guided self-work, an anchor point for the band if available.
x202.materiel: An anchored band, or bodyweight only
etapes: (3 min) Front plank then side plank, 30 seconds each position.
(5 min) Band anti-rotation, straight arms resisting the pull without the torso turning, 3 sets of 10 per side.
(4 min) Dynamic core, straight arm opposite straight leg, then plank with shoulder taps, 2 sets of 8 per side.
x202.consignes: The trunk stays still while the arms and legs move, that's where the work is. Hips locked, steady breathing.
x202.erreurs: The torso turns or the hips tilt.
x202.corrections: Reduce the band tension, slow down, squeeze the abs and glutes.
x202.reussite: Trunk perfectly stable on every rep.
x202.vEasy: No band, static core work only.
x202.vHard: Increase the tension and the range of the arm movements.

x203.titre: End of possession trailing on the scoreboard
x203.objectif: Keep a clear decision when the score is against you and possession time is very short.
x203.placement: Team on offense against a set defense, mock losing score displayed, a designated possession decision-maker and a communication relay.
x203.materiel: 1 ball, a mock scoreboard, a stopwatch
etapes: (4 min) The decision-maker states an intention in one short sentence before the ball is put in play.
(6 min) The team plays one full possession per attempt, no free reset, with very short possession time.
(4 min) After each attempt, note only: decision followed, execution correct, result, then go again.
x203.consignes: One sentence per decision, one speaker, no negotiating during the possession.
x203.erreurs: Long discussion about the previous possession, decision changing mid-play.
x203.corrections: Cut the possession time even more if the team hesitates, demand an intention sentence before each attempt.
x203.reussite: The stated decision is carried through to the end, no debate during the possession.
x203.vEasy: A bit more possession time, smaller deficit.
x203.vHard: Add higher defensive pressure and a bigger score gap.

x204.objectif: Stay aligned on a single decision priority even when a mistake costs dearly on the scoreboard.
x204.placement: Series of three attempts in a row, losing score, one possession constraint: inbound under pressure or possession after a foul.
etapes: (4 min) First attempt, the team reads then picks an action, without rushing.
(4 min) Second attempt, the team executes without changing course from the first.
(4 min) Third attempt, the team has to do better despite the pressure, a penalty applies for every rule broken.
x204.consignes: The decision-maker can only call one type of priority for the whole series.
x204.erreurs: Changing priority between the three attempts, debating during the series.
x204.corrections: Repeat the single priority before each attempt, debrief for 60 seconds max after the series.
x204.reussite: The priority stays the same over all three attempts, even after a penalty.
x204.vEasy: Two attempts instead of three, lighter penalty.
x204.vHard: Four attempts, heavier penalty for every communication slip.

x205.objectif: Force team cohesion through limited, rhythmic and useful communication at the end of a possession.
x205.placement: Possessions with a losing score, only one relay allowed to talk, three keywords max prepared in advance.
etapes: (3 min) Introduce the three keywords and the exact action tied to each one.
(7 min) Directed possessions where only the relay says the keyword as soon as the ball is set up.
(4 min) Change a single outside factor, fatigue or possession time, keeping the same decision language.
x205.consignes: One speaker during the possession, the rest of the team executes without talking.
x205.erreurs: Several players talking at once, keyword called too late.
x205.corrections: Cut to two keywords if the read gets confused, slow the tempo for one possession to reset.
x205.reussite: The keyword is called at the right moment, followed by a clear decision and execution.
x205.vHard: Three keywords with forced side changes at a fast rate.

x206.titre: Trailing score, limited time, back to the plan
x206.objectif: Combine a trailing score, limited time and fatigue to install a protocol for returning to the game plan.
x206.placement: Score gap on the board, reduced possession time, a decision leader named before the session.
etapes: (5 min) Set the conditions: score gap displayed and reduced possession time, fast but controlled transition.
(6 min) As soon as a trigger shows up, time dropping below a threshold or a possession with no threat, the leader calls back to the plan and gives one single cue.
(5 min) Final clean-up, cut the possession time again while keeping the protocol intact.
x206.consignes: The leader gives one single cue for the direction of play, no group discussion during play.
x206.erreurs: Several players suggesting different solutions at once, rushing the first shot available.
x206.corrections: Repeat the exact trigger, ease the constraint long enough to settle back down.
x206.reussite: The team repeats the same structure until the threat improves, with no conflicting choices.
x206.vEasy: Smaller score gap, normal possession time.
x206.vHard: Big score gap, very short possession time, fatigue built up before the sequence.

x207.titre: Simulated timeout, talk in twenty seconds
x207.objectif: Make the timeout predictable so the team knows what to say and do even under fatigue.
x207.placement: Simulated bad end of a sequence, immediate timeout, a designated leader and two relays.
etapes: (3 min) Play a bad end of sequence, poor ball movement or forced shot, then call timeout.
(5 min) The leader talks for twenty seconds with three required sentences: breathe, read, execute.
(4 min) Back on the floor, the next play has to follow the same format as soon as the team slips.
x207.consignes: At least two relays, each repeats one single instruction: one defensive read and one offensive responsibility.
x207.erreurs: Timeout that drags on, too many players talking at once.
x207.corrections: Time the timeout out loud, cut it as soon as the format goes over twenty seconds.
x207.reussite: The timeout lasts twenty seconds, the next play follows the stated format.
x207.vEasy: Thirty-second timeout to get used to the format.
x207.vHard: Fifteen-second timeout with fatigue built up before the sequence.

x208.titre: Mistakes in a row, one single recovery plan
x208.objectif: Prevent the snowball effect by installing a short procedure after a first mistake.
x208.placement: Two problems in a row set up on purpose: a poorly weighted pass followed by an incomplete defensive read.
etapes: (4 min) Set up the two problems in a row to trigger the snowball effect.
(6 min) From the second mistake, the leader uses the keyword stop-reset, then calls back to tempo.
(4 min) The team repeats three action words, cut, read, rebound, each tied to a responsibility on the next possession.
x208.consignes: No individual explaining of the mistake during the sequence, go back to the recovery plan.
x208.erreurs: Every player justifying their mistake, attention scattered after the second error.
x208.corrections: Cut off every explanation, restart straight on the next possession with the keyword.
x208.reussite: The team gets its tempo back after the keyword, without going back to discussion.
x208.vEasy: Only one problem set up instead of two.
x208.vHard: Three problems in a row before the protocol is triggered.

x209.objectif: Make responsibilities non-negotiable when two players can legitimately act on the same situation.
x209.placement: A situation where two players can act: a screen that changes the defensive responsibility, or an ambiguous offensive option.
etapes: (4 min) Create the role conflict on purpose on a repeated action.
(4 min) A leader and a relay are named, when in doubt the leader decides with no debate.
(4 min) Chain test, two cycles then raise the speed to make the response automatic.
x209.consignes: The relay asks one single confirmation question before the action, never during it.
x209.erreurs: Two players arguing during play over who takes the action, hesitation that kills the rhythm.
x209.corrections: Remind who the deciding leader is before restarting, ban any discussion during play.
x209.reussite: The answer comes before the argument, everyone knows their role without needing to talk about it.
x209.vEasy: Conflict situation announced to the players in advance.
x209.vHard: Conflict situation not announced, faster execution.

x210.titre: Back to the game plan, restart without going in circles
x210.objectif: Avoid collective improvisation after a crisis by putting the game plan back at the center.
x210.placement: The team has just lost its organization, a designated leader and a prepared refocus word.
etapes: (3 min) As soon as the team loses its organization, the leader says the refocus word and asks for eye contact from everyone.
(7 min) Structured restart, same first action from the game plan every cycle, four possessions in a row with the same format.
(4 min) Before each possession, the group calls out one single piece of information: our trigger is ready.
x210.consignes: Debrief limited to how the protocol was run: timing, clarity, respect of roles, never the frustration.
x210.erreurs: Looking for a new idea every possession instead of going back to the known plan.
x210.corrections: Always bring it back to the first action of the game plan before accepting a variation.
x210.reussite: All four possessions keep the same communication format, with no drift.
x210.vEasy: Two possessions in a row instead of four.
x210.vHard: Six possessions in a row with the opposing defense changing.

x211.titre: Inbound plays, the plan without panic
x211.objectif: Make inbound plays automatic so the team knows what to do before even discussing it.
x211.placement: Three inbound scenarios: sideline at quarter court, baseline after a stoppage, inbound after a made basket.
etapes: (4 min) One single talk before the inbound, same keyword every time, then run it with no negotiating.
(6 min) Work the three inbound scenarios with a fixed count given by the passer.
(4 min) Add realistic defensive pressure on the receiver, only the second action adjusts.
x211.consignes: Judge how fast the team gets set and how well it executes, not how pretty it looks.
x211.erreurs: Too much talk before the inbound, first action changed under pressure.
x211.corrections: Go back to the single keyword, remind them that only the second action adjusts to the defense.
x211.reussite: The first option comes fast, lanes and screen timing stay lined up.
x211.vEasy: Work one inbound scenario at a time.
x211.vHard: Run the three scenarios back to back with constant defensive pressure.

x212.titre: Choice after the screen, three shot levels under pressure
x212.objectif: Lock in the end-of-game decision protocol based on the defense's reaction to the screen.
x212.placement: Three shot levels triggered by the same team call, the defense reacts differently at each level.
etapes: (4 min) Level one: quick shot right away after a simple read when the defense is late.
(5 min) Level two: reset the ball after light contact when the defense slides toward the screen.
(5 min) Level three: second-read option when the defense takes away the shot, pivot option or the passer's lane.
x212.consignes: One action word and one decision word only: attack, then choose.
x212.erreurs: Too many options after the screen, hesitation that closes the shot window.
x212.corrections: Limit it to one option per level, call out the score situation before each set without changing the technical plan.
x212.reussite: Every level produces a shot inside the set time window.
x212.vEasy: Work one level at a time, no clock.
x212.vHard: Mix the three levels at random with a tight execution clock.

x213.titre: Free throws under fatigue, keep the routine
x213.objectif: Train the free throw routine as a ritual that holds up under fatigue and breathlessness.
x213.placement: One shooter at the line, a fatigue block before each set of free throws.
etapes: (4 min) Get tired before each set: ninety seconds of controlled intensity, sprints and changes of pace.
(6 min) Run a routine of five identical steps before the shot: eyes, breathing, stance, rhythm, release.
(4 min) Three sets of five free throws, call the target in your head, then let the body follow.
x213.consignes: Change only one thing at a time, the rhythm, not the whole routine.
x213.erreurs: Correcting right after a miss, which breaks the repetition.
x213.corrections: Go back to the routine with no comment after a miss, only track stance consistency and smooth motion.
x213.reussite: The routine stays the same whatever the fatigue, the percentage holds steady across sets.
x213.vHard: Harder fatigue and longer free throw sets.
x213.stats: Free throw percentage, free throws under pressure

x214.titre: One possession can change everything, four end-of-game scenarios
x214.objectif: Combine offensive choice, inbound play, short communication and clock management based on the score gap.
x214.placement: Four scenarios worked separately: tied with twenty seconds left, down with twenty-five seconds, up with fifteen seconds, down with ten seconds.
etapes: (4 min) Set the frame: who talks, who watches, who triggers, one exchange before running it.
(8 min) Run each scenario with realistic time, change only one variable at a time, defensive read or receiver's spot.
(4 min) Stop right after the play, fifteen seconds of factual review on one sequence mistake, no judgment on effort.
x214.consignes: Priority to the most reliable shot when tied, to saving clock when down, to ball security when up.
x214.erreurs: Rushing that breaks the end-of-game sequence, plan changed mid-play.
x214.corrections: Repeat the scenario until you get a shot inside the target window, finish with one clean, slow rep.
x214.reussite: Every scenario produces a decision that matches the stated priority, with no panic.
x214.vEasy: One scenario per session, a bit more time on the clock.
x214.vHard: All four scenarios back to back in the same practice.

x215.titre: Successive helps, defense arriving before the ball
x215.objectif: Trigger help as soon as the driving lane closes, without waiting to see the attack finished.
x215.placement: 3 on 2, the offensive player makes a lead pass, the defender triggers help on a fixed cue.
etapes: (3 min) Set three cues, distance, angle, line, each tied to an action: close, slide, make contact.
(6 min) Help-and-recover drills: the help takes the space, then the recovery stops the second driving lane.
(5 min) Two sets of full possessions, judge only the help-then-recover chain, not the shot.
x215.consignes: Only one alert word allowed during play, for example "help", to avoid noise.
x215.erreurs: Several players yelling at once, help arriving with no recovery behind it.
x215.corrections: Go back to the three cues before restarting, demand the single alert word.
x215.reussite: The help allows an immediate recovery and the door shuts on the way back.
x215.vHard: 4 on 3 with a forced ball reversal.

x216.titre: Emergency rotations, holding a bad screen together
x216.objectif: Make the collective reaction automatic after a bad angle or a screen set too cleanly.
x216.placement: Controlled 4 on 4, the screen comes at the same moment on every rep.
etapes: (3 min) Give each role a clear name: the one beaten first recovers, the one cutting off closes, the one who sees talks.
(6 min) Trap-screen station: the offense has one option only, pass or drive, the defense applies one expected answer.
(5 min) Evaluation possessions, the only goal is to stop the first-option basket.
x216.consignes: A slow, forced shot is fine if the rotation is in place, don't chase the prettiest game.
x216.erreurs: Players improvising alone against the screen, rotation arriving too late.
x216.corrections: Remind them of the named roles before restarting, slow the screen down if the read is confused.
x216.reussite: The rotation triggers at the right time, talk stays minimal but enough.
x216.vEasy: 3 on 3 with one type of screen only.
x216.vHard: 5 on 5 with repeated screens on both sides.
x216.stats: Points allowed on pick and roll, successful rotations

x217.titre: Five-player rebound, securing the end of possession
x217.objectif: Install a cohesion principle where everyone crashes the boards, nobody just watches.
x217.placement: Waves of controlled shots, steady pace, one defensive instruction at a time.
etapes: (4 min) Position adjustment: keep the safety foot and the angle to the ball before each shot.
(6 min) Shot waves with one signal telling everyone when to lock in on the rebound.
(4 min) Team competition, a team wins if the rebound is secured and the outlet found within two passes.
x217.consignes: Body contact allowed, pulling on arms not allowed.
x217.erreurs: A player watching the shot instead of getting in position, rushed outlet with no passer ready.
x217.corrections: Remind them of the lock-in signal before each wave, slow the pace if positioning is wrong.
x217.reussite: The rebound is secured, then the outlet is found within the next two passes.
x217.vEasy: Slower shooting pace, no opposition on the rebound.
x217.vHard: Fast pace with active opposition on the rebound.
x217.stats: Defensive rebounds and outlets, second chances

x218.titre: Communication on switches, talking without contradicting
x218.objectif: Synchronize words and movement so the defense does not fragment when the opponent speeds up.
x218.placement: Half-court reps, the offense changes pace, the defense uses a three-call vocabulary.
etapes: (3 min) Set one call for the switch, one call for help, one call for getting back, the same on every rep.
(6 min) Rep it on the half court, stop right away if a word gets lost or a move doesn't match the call.
(5 min) End-of-possession simulations, one goal only: be set before the attacker's last dribble.
x218.consignes: Only one person starts the call, the others can add to it without taking over the role.
x218.erreurs: Several players giving conflicting calls, getting louder instead of clearer.
x218.corrections: Go back to the three-call vocabulary, demand that the same player starts the call for the whole sequence.
x218.reussite: The team is set before the last dribble, without getting needlessly louder.
x218.vEasy: Work one type of call at a time.
x218.vHard: All three calls combined with changes of pace forced by the offense.
x218.stats: Points allowed, points allowed on pick and roll

x219.objectif: Keep the dribble clean when a light constraint appears, without panicking.
x219.placement: Players spread in a tight area, short moves, controlled dribble at moderate speed.
etapes: (3 min) Footwork warm-up, short moves with a controlled dribble.
(6 min) Dribble patterns under light pressure, controlled distance, immediate correction.
(3 min) Semi-combined drill where the pressure triggers one action: stop, crossover, or pass.
x219.consignes: The pressure should make the dribble harder, never break the stance.
x219.erreurs: Ball bouncing up high, unstable stop after the pressure.
x219.corrections: Reduce the pressure and lock in the mechanics if the stop gets unstable.
x219.reussite: Head up, ball low and steady, clean crossovers with no panic.
x219.vEasy: Pressure spaced further apart in time.
x219.vHard: Two quick pressures back to back at close range.

x220.titre: Visual dissociation, reading without losing the ball
x220.objectif: Usefully look at a signal while keeping control of the dribble.
x220.placement: Dribblers facing a session leader who gives distinct visual signals.
etapes: (4 min) Step one: one visual signal, one allowed answer, crossover or stop.
(4 min) Step two: the signal comes right before the ball is back under control, answer right after the dribble.
(4 min) Step three: signal combined with a rhythm constraint, short burst, then decision.
x220.consignes: Go with two or three clearly distinct signals rather than six average ones.
x220.erreurs: Eyes staying on the ball, late answer to the signal.
x220.corrections: Go back to one signal if the read is confused, slow down how often the signal appears.
x220.reussite: The answer comes right after the signal, with no lost ball and no long hesitation.
x220.vHard: Three signals combined with a forced burst of speed.

x221.objectif: Make the offensive pivot useful by linking it to a clean passing lane rather than an isolated move.
x221.placement: Catch on a controlled stop, pivot set, then pass out in 1 on 0, then with light pressure on the lane.
etapes: (4 min) Setup: pivot set from a catch, focus on stability, hips, feet, balance.
(5 min) Pivot, then read: choose the passing hand based on the open lane without telegraphing.
(5 min) Pivot, then pass on the move: pass after coming out of the pivot, not while your center of gravity collapses.
x221.consignes: The chest turns before the ball, but the preparation comes first.
