x221.erreurs: Pivot drifting away with no anchored pivot foot, pass telegraphed by the eyes or the arm.
x221.corrections: Strengthen the anchor on the pivot foot, demand neutral eyes before the pass.
x221.reussite: Clean exit from the pivot, the pass goes when the lane is there, not when the defender arrives.
x221.vEasy: 1 on 0 only, no pressure on the lane.
x221.vHard: Light pressure on the passing lane with a simulated steal.

x222.titre: Footwork, passing and defensive reading in small numbers
x222.objectif: Combine quality footwork, passing choice and reading defensive signals with a reduced number of players.
x222.placement: Progressive small-sided situations, simple goal: keep the ball and open a lane.
etapes: (4 min) Setup with simple goals: keep the ball, open a lane, force a defensive reaction.
(6 min) Passing rule: pass after a stable base to avoid rushed moves.
(4 min) Short final small-sided game, immediate debrief on pass quality and reading how the defense closes.
x222.consignes: If the lane is closed, the ball handler changes pace or protects with a safe dribble until the option opens.
x222.erreurs: Rushed pass before a stable base, not reading the defense closing.
x222.corrections: Slow down the passing rhythm, remind them of the stable-base rule before each exchange.
x222.reussite: Pass made from a stable base, correct read of the defense closing or sagging off.
x222.vHard: Bigger numbers, 5 on 4 with a time limit.

x223.titre: Shooting mechanics at low speed, zero compromise
x223.objectif: Link every technical shooting cue to a simple, repeatable check, without speed.
x223.placement: Shooters close to the rim, pace kept slow on purpose.
etapes: (3 min) Shooting warm-up, six to eight shots right at the rim, one cue per set: feet, then eyes, then elbow aligned.
(2 min) Stance ritual, hold your balance for two seconds before you shoot.
(6 min) Mechanics sequence with no speed-up, three sets of guided reps, slow pace, soft finish through the fingers.
(3 min) Back to the target, two sets of shots from the same distance, same tempo as the reps.
x223.consignes: Stable feet, eyes locked on the target, elbow under the ball, soft follow-through.
x223.erreurs: Weight falling back on the heels, elbow flaring out sideways when speeding up.
x223.corrections: Go back to the slow pace as soon as one cue slips, correct one cue at a time.
x223.reussite: The same shooting form can be repeated at will, with clear cues.
x223.vHard: Add a slightly longer distance while keeping the same tempo.

x224.titre: Zone series, spotting strong and weak angles
x224.objectif: Isolate foot orientation and shoulder placement to identify strong and weak shooting angles.
x224.placement: Shooting zones close in, then mid-range, same starting ritual at every zone.
etapes: (4 min) Warm-up reading the floor, mobility, then adjustment steps toward the ball.
(5 min) Close-range technical set, three sets of five shots, feet pointed at the rim, shoulders square to the shot line.
(5 min) Fixed mid-range spot, three sets of five shots, same starting ritual.
(2 min) Consistent follow-through, two sets of six shots holding the arm up after release.
x224.consignes: The measure isn't just the ball going in, it's repeating the same alignment.
x224.erreurs: Duck-footed shot, shoulder ahead of or behind the feet.
x224.corrections: Fix the foot alignment first, then the shoulder.
x224.reussite: Shots look the same from one zone to the next, with a known percentage for each angle.
x224.vEasy: Two zones only, close shots only.
x224.vHard: Add a tough angle zone spotted during the review.

x225.titre: Shots off one or two dribbles, without losing alignment
x225.objectif: Make shooting accuracy survive the impact of the dribble.
x225.placement: Start off a short dribble, one or two dribbles max before the shot, always back to feet-shoulder alignment.
etapes: (4 min) One dribble, stop and shoot, check alignment before the release.
(5 min) Two dribbles with a slight change of pace, then stop and shoot.
(5 min) Alternate both formats with a short reset between sets.
x225.consignes: The stop before the shot should look like your stationary shot stop, not a hard brake.
x225.erreurs: Shoulders out of line after the dribble, rushed shot before getting balanced.
x225.corrections: Add a one-second pause after the stop before the shot is allowed.
x225.reussite: The shot off the dribble matches the stationary shot in follow-through quality.
x225.vEasy: One dribble only, no change of pace.
x225.vHard: Two dribbles with a required crossover before the stop.

x226.titre: Catch-and-shoot off a mismatch, installing the open-shot reflex
x226.objectif: Turn an extra pass into an open shot taken without hesitation.
x226.placement: Ball moving, an extra pass creates the advantage, the shooter catches while moving toward the target.
etapes: (4 min) Simple ball movement, one pass that creates a clear advantage.
(6 min) Catch already facing the target, shoot right away if the space is open.
(4 min) Variation with a decision: shoot, attack, or kick out depending on how the defense closes.
x226.consignes: Catch already turned toward the rim, no extra time to reset your feet.
x226.erreurs: Catching with your back to the play, hesitation that gives the defense time to close.
x226.corrections: Demand a catch facing the target, fix the running angle toward the ball.
x226.reussite: The shot goes up as soon as the space is confirmed open, no dead time after the catch.
x226.vEasy: The shooter is told about the advantage in advance.
x226.vHard: No warning, with a defender who closes out fast.

x227.titre: A base stance that secures everything
x227.objectif: Install a repeatable defensive posture, low and stable, without losing balance.
x227.placement: Ball handler and defender face to face, marked-off one on one space.
etapes: (3 min) Starting stance: feet wider than shoulders, knees bent, chest leaning slightly forward, hands ready.
(4 min) Active feet, small controlled moves without hopping or losing alignment.
(3 min) Balance under pressure, small changes of direction while staying low.
(2 min) One on one against the ball handler, react to the first offensive move.
x227.consignes: Solid defense doesn't start with the arms, it starts with the feet.
x227.erreurs: Chest collapsing, defender standing too far from or too close to the ball handler.
x227.corrections: Remind them of the safe distance, straighten the chest without stiffening it.
x227.reussite: Players stay low and stable while moving, without bouncing up.
x227.vEasy: Static one on one, the ball handler doesn't change direction.
x227.vHard: One on one with repeated changes of pace from the ball handler.

x228.titre: Ball side, help side, simultaneous reading
x228.objectif: Read the direct opponent and the ball at the same time to help at the right moment without being caught off guard.
x228.placement: Defense set against an offense moving the ball, one defender in a potential help position.
etapes: (4 min) Ball-side read: the ball handler's defender shuts the direct driving lane.
(6 min) Help-side read: the defender away from the ball adjusts position to be able to step in.
(4 min) Full situation: the ball moves, each defender switches between ball side and help side based on where the ball is.
x228.consignes: Position adjusts on every pass, not just at the start of the play.
x228.erreurs: Help-side defender stuck to his man, late adjustment after a pass.
x228.corrections: Slow the ball movement down to give time to adjust position.
x228.reussite: Every defender is in position to help or close depending on where the ball is.
x228.vEasy: Slower ball movement, two passes max.
x228.vHard: Fast ball movement with passes both ways.

x229.objectif: Trigger help as soon as the drive starts in the controlled zone, and close the paint back up.
x229.placement: Attacker on a controlled drive, a help defender positioned ahead of the play.
etapes: (4 min) Recognize the drive trigger: the help defender spots the exact moment to step in.
(6 min) Help, then contact: the help defender closes the paint without giving up an easy shot.
(4 min) Recover and cover: straight back to your own man after the help.
x229.consignes: The help arrives before the attacker finishes his move, not after.
x229.erreurs: Help arriving too late, no recovery to the original man after helping.
x229.corrections: Slow the drive down to fix the help timing, remind them the recovery is mandatory.
x229.reussite: The drive is stopped in the paint, the recovery happens without giving up an open shot.
x229.vEasy: The help defender is told about the drive in advance.
x229.vHard: Drive with a second attacker ready to catch if the help comes.
x229.stats: Points in the paint, points allowed

x230.objectif: Chain several defensive rotations while keeping rim protection as the absolute priority.
x230.placement: Controlled 5 on 5, one help triggers a chain rotation across two or three players.
etapes: (4 min) First rotation: the help defender covers, the next one adjusts his line.
(6 min) Second chain rotation: a third defender protects the paint while the others adjust.
(4 min) Full live situation, priority called out loud before each possession: protect the rim first.
x230.consignes: The last link in the chain always protects the paint, even if it means giving up an outside shot.
x230.erreurs: Rotation stopping after the first link, a player leaving the rim to close out on the perimeter.
x230.corrections: Remind them of the priority order before restarting, slow the play down if the chain breaks.
x230.reussite: The rotation chain closes all the way, the rim stays protected.
x230.vHard: Three-player rotation with a second help.

x231.titre: Recognizing a defensive lag and the right trigger
x231.objectif: Spot early a defender who is late or a closeout that comes too late, to trigger the right action.
x231.placement: 3 on 3, ball moving at controlled speed.
etapes: (4 min) Observation rule: look before every pass to spot a late defender.
(5 min) Main drill: each time a defender is late, the ball handler instantly chooses to attack, draw the defense, or pass.
(3 min) Cool-down read, short stop to say out loud the clues you saw.
x231.consignes: A shot is only allowed if the chosen action created a clear advantage for the receiver.
x231.erreurs: Mistaking a late defender for a real opening, rushed shot with no clear lane.
x231.corrections: Remind them that a late defender isn't always an opening, when in doubt, draw and pass.
x231.reussite: The player reads before deciding, the chosen action matches what the defense actually gave up.
x231.vEasy: Passive defense to make the late defender easier to read.
x231.vHard: Defense that mixes its closeouts to make the read harder.

x232.titre: Two on one, the decision that changes everything
x232.objectif: Install the core principle of numbers advantage, don't look for the individual highlight but the decision that punishes the extra man.
x232.placement: 2 on 1, starting from a controlled transition.
etapes: (4 min) Read the defender: the player with the ball sees who the defender chooses to cover.
(5 min) Instant decision: pass to the open teammate, or attack if the defender stays on the potential passer.
(3 min) Quick reps switching roles, without slowing the transition pace.
x232.consignes: One pass is enough if the read is right, don't look for a second option you don't need.
x232.erreurs: Pass too late once the defender has already committed, forced shot instead of the obvious pass.
x232.corrections: Slow the transition down so the read is clearer, repeat with focus on passing at the right time.
x232.reussite: The numbers advantage ends with an easy shot, created by the right read of the defender.
x232.vHard: Active defender who fakes his position to fool the read.

x233.titre: The cut that comes after the read
x233.objectif: Trigger the cut only when the defensive read makes it worthwhile, not as an automatic reflex.
x233.placement: One ball handler, one off-ball player who watches his defender before cutting.
etapes: (4 min) Observation: the off-ball player watches his defender before deciding to move.
(5 min) Cut only when the defender loses focus or turns his back to the ball.
(3 min) Reps with an immediate reward pass when the cut is read right.
x233.consignes: The cut is a solution, not a reflex, it comes when the passing lane is ready.
x233.erreurs: Cutting every time without reading the defender, timing too early that closes the passing lane.
x233.corrections: Slow the pace so the player has time to look before cutting.
x233.reussite: The cut comes when the defender is distracted, the pass follows right away.
x233.vEasy: Defender who turns away in a predictable way.
x233.vHard: Defender who changes his focus to make the read harder.

x234.titre: Organized transition defense, protecting the middle
x234.objectif: Make defensive transition automatic as soon as the ball is lost, with a clear role for the first player back.
x234.placement: Simulated turnover on offense, immediate transition to getting back on defense.
etapes: (4 min) Get back as soon as the ball is lost, the first player back protects the middle.
(6 min) The other defenders organize around the first player back, immediate talk about who has who.
(4 min) Full situation: stop the opponent's fast break, priority to preventing the easy basket.
x234.consignes: The first player back protects the middle before trying to win the ball.
x234.erreurs: Disorganized running with nobody protecting the middle, no talk between players getting back.
x234.corrections: Remind them of the first player back's role, slow the opponent's break until the reflex sticks.
x234.reussite: The middle is protected before the defense is fully set.
x234.vHard: Opponent's break with a numbers advantage.

x235.titre: Five-player motion offense against man-to-man defense
x235.objectif: Occupy space continuously to create positional advantages through collective movement.
x235.placement: Five players: two on the sides for width, one in support on the ball side, two ready to open up depth.
etapes: (5 min) Setup: the pass starts the first cut, the passer relocates to give a third option.
(6 min) Flow: after the catch, the ball handler looks for the pass that puts the defender in trouble.
(5 min) Cuts without rushing: a cut comes when the passing lane is ready, then finish with a clean shot.
x235.consignes: After the pass, every player shows up again in the right spot, the passer doesn't disappear.
x235.erreurs: Several players bunched in the same spot, cut made with no passing lane ready.
x235.corrections: Remind them of the width and depth spots, correct one point at a time.
x235.reussite: The ball moves with purpose, every move opens a new passing lane.
x235.vEasy: Passive defense to give time to read the spaces.
x235.vHard: Defense sliding actively to close the passing lanes.

x236.titre: Ball screen with continuation, from timing to decision
x236.objectif: Make the ball screen effective through angle and timing, even before the ball moves.
x236.placement: Point guard and big in a ball screen, defense changing its coverage.
etapes: (4 min) Screen angle work: the screener picks the angle that really cuts off the defender's path.
(5 min) Screen timing: the ball handler waits until the screen is set before using it.
(5 min) Decision after the screen: attack the rim, kick out to the trailer, or hit the screener on the roll.
x236.consignes: The screen has to work before the ball even moves, not just at contact.
x236.erreurs: Using the screen before it's set, same decision whatever the defensive coverage.
x236.corrections: Slow the timing so the screen is set before it's used, change the coverage to sharpen the read.
x236.reussite: The decision after the screen matches exactly the coverage the defense shows.
x236.vEasy: One defensive coverage at a time.
x236.vHard: Mixed coverages with no warning to the ball handler.
x236.stats: Pick and roll efficiency, points allowed on pick and roll

x237.titre: Secondary transition when the easy basket isn't there
x237.objectif: Follow up with an organized second wave when the first transition doesn't produce an easy basket.
x237.placement: Quick first transition, then switch to a second-wave setup if no easy shot shows up.
etapes: (4 min) Quick first transition, look for the easy basket first.
(6 min) If the easy basket isn't there, switch right away to a second-wave setup with quick spacing.
(4 min) Full situation: decide between keeping the transition going or moving into the half-court offense without losing rhythm.
x237.consignes: The switch to the second wave has to be immediate, not after a moment of hesitation.
x237.erreurs: Still hunting for an easy basket that's gone, turnover from rushing at the end of the transition.
x237.corrections: Set a dribble count or a time limit before the switch to the second wave is required.
x237.reussite: The team goes from the fast break to an organized offense with no break in the flow.
x237.vEasy: Defense that takes more time to get back.
x237.vHard: Defense that gets back fast and takes away the easy basket from the start.

x238.titre: Inbound and last possession, tempo without panic
x238.objectif: Manage the last possession as a scenario with conditions, not as improvisation.
x238.placement: Simulated inbound with limited time left, one offensive choice set in advance based on the score.
etapes: (4 min) Set the frame: who talks, who triggers, one exchange before running it.
(6 min) Run the scenario with realistic time, change only one variable at a time.
(4 min) After the play, short factual review of any sequence mistake.
x238.consignes: The offensive choice is set before the inbound, not discussed after.
x238.erreurs: Inbound delayed by talking, plan changed after the first dribble.
x238.corrections: Repeat the scenario until you get a shot inside the target window, finish with one slow, clean rep.
x238.reussite: The last possession produces a shot within the time left, consistent with the announced plan.
x238.vHard: Very little time left, defense pressuring the inbound.

x239.titre: The rules and the safety dribble
x239.objectif: Set a simple framework and make the dribble clean before increasing speed.
x239.placement: Each player with a ball, work zones marked on the floor.
etapes: (2 min) Go over three safety rules: one ball, one control; stop first, decide second; every dribble has a purpose.
(6 min) Safety dribble: low control, steady tempo, controlled stop on command.
(4 min) Dribble to a marker, stop, then a short pass to a stationary teammate.
(2 min) Quick review: what was respected, what to fix first.
x239.consignes: No speed until the stop is stable. Ball security comes before intensity.
x239.erreurs: Dribble too high, ball getting away without the rhythm stopping.
x239.corrections: Stop and reset the form as soon as the ball gets away, bring the dribble back low and close to the body.
x239.reussite: The dribble stays low and steady, the stop is stable before every pass.
x239.vHard: Two markers with a required crossover between them.

x240.objectif: Make stops usable in decision-making, without turning the ball over.
x240.placement: Players in a line, controlled approach to a stop mark.
etapes: (4 min) Jump stop: controlled approach, stable landing, first foot brakes without twisting.
(4 min) Two-step stop: same start, the second foot settles the body and sets up the exit.
(3 min) Dribble, stop, go again: stop on command, then short pass or restart the dribble.
(3 min) Guided situation, one decision rule at a time: stop or go.
x240.consignes: One decision at a time: stop to protect and go again cleanly, or keep going if the lane is open.
x240.erreurs: Ball going forward before the stop is finished, the stop collapses.
x240.corrections: Go back to stable feet before asking for speed again.
x240.reussite: Jump stop and two-step stop done without the body falling forward.
x240.vEasy: Slower approach, shorter distance before the stop.
x240.vHard: Faster approach with a required decision after the stop.

x241.objectif: Make distances automatic so every pass opens a lane and sets up the next one.
x241.placement: Three lanes: width on the left, middle lane, width on the right.
etapes: (3 min) Spacing rule before every action: check the line of sight and the safe distance before passing.
(6 min) Play with two, then three support players, every pass has to open a lane and set up the next catch.
(3 min) Quick reset, targeted correction on one or two mistakes max, then restart right away.
(2 min) Review: count the completed passes with clean space to receive the next one.
x241.consignes: The measure isn't the number of passes, it's the number of completed passes with clean space behind them.
x241.erreurs: Players too close together who close the angles, catching with your back to the play.
x241.corrections: Remind them of the safe distance and demand a catch facing the court.
x241.reussite: Passing lanes stay easy to read, every catch opens a new option.
x241.vEasy: Two support players only, no defense.
x241.vHard: Three support players with a defense sliding to close the angles.

x242.objectif: Turn the pass into useful movement, without the passer disappearing after playing the ball.
x242.placement: Two or three players: a passer, a receiver, a set return zone.
etapes: (3 min) The passer gets into a stable position right after the pass, eyes on the next option.
(6 min) The receiver makes a first read: protect the ball, then open the best return lane.
(3 min) Every give-and-go aims at a precise spot, speed comes from structure, not the other way around.
(2 min) If the connection breaks, bad spacing or bad timing, go back to the simple version and start again.
x242.consignes: The give-and-go needs a clear destination, otherwise you're just running for nothing.
x242.erreurs: Catching with your back to the play, passer standing still after the pass.
x242.corrections: Demand a stable base from the passer before any restart, adjust the catch angle.
x242.reussite: The passer becomes a useful option again after the pass, with no dead time in the movement.
x242.vHard: Chained three-player give-and-go with light defense.

x243.objectif: Link a stable stop to a clean shot trigger, the stop first, the finish second.
x243.placement: Two lines facing the basket, start from a short distance, a mark on the floor for the stop.
etapes: (4 min) Controlled steps and footwork along the arc, look for a foot that lands rather than a foot that drops.
(6 min) Stop on signal, then shoot: short run, stop on the mark, last step short and controlled, soft knees.
(4 min) Half-turn stop, then shoot after resetting: small controlled pivot to square shoulders and feet to the basket.
(2 min) Session review: two counted sets of shots for consistency, not for max makes.
x243.consignes: A good stop doesn't need to be flashy, it has to be stable, quiet, and set up the shot.
x243.erreurs: Last step too long, eyes leaving the target during the stop.
x243.corrections: Shorten the last step and demand eyes on the target until the end of the motion.
x243.reussite: The stop is stable on every rep, the follow-through matches the stationary shots.
x243.vHard: Add the half-turn reset on every rep.

x244.objectif: Synchronize the movement off the screen with the shot, without overplaying the motion.
x244.placement: A screener, a shooter coming off, a passer who feeds at the right moment.
etapes: (5 min) Coming off the screen: the shoulder leads the direction, the feet set the shot angle before the catch.
(5 min) Quick shot after the catch: as soon as the shot window opens, shoot without sizing up the defense too long.
(4 min) Consistent finishes: keep the same release feel on every rep without breaking alignment.
(2 min) Review: check you're balanced within two steps max after the catch.
x244.consignes: Start every rep with the body already facing the target, even before coming off the screen.
x244.erreurs: An extra comfort step after the catch, late shot that wastes the speed the screen created.
x244.corrections: Limit the catch to two steps max, remind them the shot goes as soon as the lane is there.
x244.reussite: The whole sequence speeds up, not just the arm, with eyes on the target the whole time.
x244.vEasy: Static screen, no defender on the shooter.
x244.vHard: Defender trailing the shooter off the screen to contest the shot.

x245.objectif: Create short, useful fatigue then return to shooting with a percentage target rather than uncontrolled volume.
x245.placement: Shooting stations close, mid-range and on the angle, alternating with short sprints.
etapes: (4 min) Technical warm-up: slow shots, soft finish through the fingers, balanced stop.
(4 min) Short fatigue block: six to eight quick down-and-backs over a short distance, active recovery.
(7 min) Percentage shooting: three sets of six shots with a number target called before starting.
(3 min) Cool-down: six easy shots to confirm the motion stays the same.
x245.consignes: Fatigue should serve the shot, not wipe it out. The percentage is your gauge, the form is your compass.
x245.erreurs: Unstable feet after the effort, eyes leaving the target, follow-through broken by rushing.
x245.corrections: Go back to one slow control shot as soon as alignment slips, before going back to the counted shots.
x245.reussite: The percentage holds despite the fatigue, the alignment matches the opening shots.
x245.vEasy: Shorter fatigue block, lower makes target.
x245.vHard: Longer fatigue block, tougher makes target.

x246.titre: Shooting percentage by zone, timed challenge
x246.objectif: Get a reliable snapshot of real shooting touch, zone by zone, in a game-like format.
x246.placement: Four clear shooting zones, close, mid-range, three-point, catch off a short pass.
etapes: (3 min) Show the four zones and the scoring rule, more points for the harder zones.
(10 min) Each player takes three sets of four shots spread across the zones, timed shot window.
(3 min) Time left is called once at the start of the set, then silence during the shots.
(2 min) Quick review right away: each player's strongest zone and weakest zone.
x246.consignes: The main indicator isn't the team score, it's each player's shooting map.
x246.erreurs: Technical cues forgotten under clock pressure, stance width changing.
x246.corrections: Remind them the cues are the same as before: stable feet, eyes locked, soft follow-through.
x246.reussite: Every player leaves with a clear record, makes out of attempts by zone.
x246.vEasy: Two zones only, longer shot window.
x246.vHard: Four zones with a shorter shot window and a passive defender.

x247.titre: Ball pressure, active hands, contested shot
x247.objectif: Create smart pressure that disrupts the dribble without opening the middle, then contest the shot after closing out.
x247.placement: Ball handler and defender face to face, marked-off one on one space.
etapes: (4 min) Pressure with active hands: crowd the dribble line without needless reaching, without diving at the ball.
(5 min) Defensive retreat: if the attacker tries to use the space created, recover under control with your chest to the ball.
(3 min) Contest after moving: last adjustment to slow down the shot preparation.
(2 min) Check: the ball handler hesitates, dribbles less comfortably, the shot isn't clean.
x247.consignes: Pressure comes from the feet and the angles, not from jumping at the ball.
x247.erreurs: Defender diving at the dribble, late retreat that opens the middle.
x247.corrections: Bring the defender back to a low stance before asking for pressure again, remind them of the safe distance.
x247.reussite: The ball handler can't get to the middle without slowing down, the final shot is contested.
x247.vEasy: Ball handler keeps a steady rhythm, no changes of direction.
x247.vHard: Ball handler mixing changes of pace and fakes.

x248.titre: Closing passing lanes and controlled interception
x248.objectif: Close priority passing lanes and intercept without exposing yourself, then recover to your player.
x248.placement: Defense set, offense offering readable passes through the middle and on the diagonals.
etapes: (4 min) Close the priority lanes: short steps, active hands, without crossing the whole court.
(5 min) Controlled steal on a called pass: the active hand cuts the lane without overrunning.
(3 min) Quick recovery to your man as soon as the pass is stopped, teammates who helped go back to covering their area.
(2 min) Check: no gap opens behind the help.
x248.consignes: Position your chest to make the pass hard, rather than trying to rip the ball away at full speed.
x248.erreurs: Defender overrunning his line to go for the steal, slow recovery to his man after the steal.
x248.corrections: Remind them of the body angle before the lane, demand an immediate recovery to the matchup after the play.
x248.reussite: The easy pass is denied, the recovery to the man leaves no lag when the tempo changes.
x248.vEasy: Close one passing lane at a time.
x248.vHard: Two passing lanes at once with quick ball reversals.

x249.titre: Calling the off-ball screen, sharing the timing
x249.objectif: Install a common language for off-ball screens, call, fight through, recover, for defensive continuity without gaps.
x249.placement: Two defenders, one guarding direct and one supporting behind, an attacker setting an off-ball screen at a called moment.
etapes: (4 min) As soon as the screen shows up, the defender calls "screen" then the useful direction, left or right.
(5 min) On the signal, the defender fights through: he crosses the screen area on active feet while watching the ball handler.
(3 min) Right after, he recovers, calling "I got him", and gets back on his line of responsibility.
(2 min) Check: one read mistake max per set.
x249.consignes: Keep the words short and the same from player to player: call, through, recover, short help.
x249.erreurs: Late call that leaves you stuck on the screen, talking without recovering position after.
x249.corrections: Demand that the call comes as soon as the screen shows up, remind them the recovery is mandatory after fighting through.
x249.reussite: The defender talks early, moves cleanly, then takes back his line with authority.
x249.vEasy: Off-ball screen called in advance by the coach.
x249.vHard: Off-ball screen coming at a random moment in the possession.
x249.stats: Points allowed on pick and roll, communication

x250.titre: Stopping the opponent's fast break and resetting into a set defense
x250.objectif: Slow the ball handler down as soon as the fast-break zone starts, then move from transition defense into a set half-court defense.
x250.placement: Simulated opponent's fast break, a first defender who makes contact, the rest of the team resetting.
etapes: (4 min) Slow the ball handler: attack the space in front of him, active but disciplined hands, no foul.
(6 min) Reset into a set defense: cover the passing lanes, a named rim protector, keep your distances.
(4 min) Full situation: stop the opponent's break, then hold an organized setup until the end of the possession.
x250.consignes: The first stop has to be clean, then the team relies on position rather than chasing.
x250.erreurs: Last defender sucked in by the ball handler, side lanes left open.
x250.corrections: Remind them who protects the rim first, slow the opponent's break until the reset sticks.
x250.reussite: The middle is protected, the talk stays clear on who takes the ball and who stays.
x250.vEasy: Opponent's break at reduced speed, even numbers.
x250.vHard: Opponent's break with a real numbers advantage.

x251.titre: Width and depth, a real driving lane
x251.objectif: Make spacing useful so a driving lane is actually reachable after the next pass, not just visible.
x251.placement: Three lanes: width on the left, middle lane, width on the right.
etapes: (4 min) Name the no-crowding zones, near the driving lane and the cutting lanes that must stay clear.
(6 min) The ball handler starts after reading: if the defense closes the middle, he runs a play that spreads a player to the right spot.
(4 min) The receiver doesn't catch facing a tight defender, he sets a direction before the catch, shot only after a pass where the space is clear.
x251.consignes: A driving lane isn't open on paper, it has to be reachable after the next pass.
x251.erreurs: Static catch facing a tight defender, pass to a space that's already gone.
x251.corrections: Demand a catch on the move that restarts the action, remind them of the no-crowding zones rule.
x251.reussite: The defense has to move to close, shots come earlier in the possession.
x251.vEasy: Reading work with no shot, passes and movement only.
x251.vHard: Add a defense that actively closes the middle.

x252.objectif: Bring out the right pair of actions in a numbers advantage, drawing the defender, extra pass, shot or finishing pass.
x252.placement: 3 on 2, set lanes at the start.
etapes: (4 min) Start in zones: attackers stay in set lanes to make passing lanes easier to read.
(5 min) The ball handler attacks a window between the defender and the middle line, if it closes he draws the defender, then passes.
(3 min) Move to constrained free play: no more than two passes before deciding on a shot, drawing the defender, or the extra pass.
(2 min) Short sequences, each team has to produce at least one play that turns the disorganization into a shot.
x252.consignes: The right pass isn't the easiest one, it's the one that creates an open shot or draws the defender cleanly.
x252.erreurs: Too many passes that waste the advantage, shot taken when the defense isn't really late.
x252.corrections: Limit the number of passes allowed, remind them a shot only counts if the defender has lost the middle.
x252.reussite: The advantage turns into a shot or a finishing pass before the defense gets organized.
x252.vEasy: 2 on 1 to set the cues before moving to 3 on 2.
x252.vHard: 3 on 2 with a third defender entering the play late.

x253.titre: Cut, then punish with the extra pass
x253.objectif: Train the sequence: synchronized cut, catch, then extra pass to the side opened by the defensive rotation.
x253.placement: A cutter, a ball handler who feeds him, an extra-pass lane open on the weak side.
etapes: (4 min) The ball handler only releases the pass when the receiver cuts into clean space, never before.
(6 min) Catch, then move the ball to the side opened by the defensive rotation, obvious extra pass.
(4 min) Drawing the defense: the ball handler holds one second without stopping to pull the help before releasing.
(2 min) Final game: cut-pass timing, punish the open side, read the defense before attacking.
x253.consignes: The pass has to travel before the defense's feet reset.
x253.erreurs: Pass made too early, before the cut creates a real advantage, extra pass aimed too far from the useful lane.
x253.corrections: Remind them the passer can't talk, the timing has to do the job.
x253.reussite: The catch on the cut becomes a relay, the extra pass arrives when the defense has already committed.
x253.vEasy: Simple cut and pass, no active defense.
x253.vHard: Defense that changes its reaction, early or late help depending on the rep.

x254.titre: Reading help and lag, choosing to drive, hold or pass
x254.objectif: Develop the read of when the defense moves to protect the rim, and choose the consistent option.
x254.placement: Four attackers, one mobile "sensor" defender who helps based on the coach's instruction.
etapes: (4 min) The ball handler only starts after a group verbal read, one keyword: help, late, or closed.
(8 min) Continuous play, the sensor defender helps at mid-range, slides to the middle, or delays the drive based on the instruction.
(4 min) The offense only scores if the decision matches the called read.
x254.consignes: If help: draw the defense right away or make a quick extra pass. If late: drive under control. If closed: change the angle.
x254.erreurs: Forced drive into a lane already closed, automatic pass when drawing the defense had created the right shot.
x254.corrections: Remind them of the keyword before each play, slow the game down if the read is confused.
x254.reussite: The keyword comes before the action, the choice matches exactly what the defense gave.
x254.vHard: The help changes during the sequence to force adjustment.

x255.objectif: Run an offensive continuity where cuts close off a dead end for the defense and replacements keep the flow of play going.
x255.placement: Five players, ball moving from one side to the other to shift the defense's feet.
etapes: (4 min) A cut is only allowed if a passing lane is clearly open, not out of habit.
(6 min) Set rhythm: two passes and a cut, then support players fill back in if the defense shifts.
(4 min) Technical penalty if a player doesn't refill his spot, the play restarts from the same position.
(2 min) Guided small game: keep the continuity going until you get a clean shot.
x255.consignes: One cut, one purpose. A refill after every pass, or the continuity stops.
x255.erreurs: Cut made with no open passing lane, passer not refilling after the pass.
x255.corrections: Apply the set technical penalty and restart the sequence from the same position.
x255.reussite: The team runs the same patterns without hesitating, the continuity produces a clean shot.
x255.vHard: Five-player continuity with a defense sliding actively.
x255.stats: Offensive flow, open shots on ball reversal

x256.objectif: Turn the advantage created by the ball screen into a tangible result through three simple reads by the ball handler.
x256.placement: Dribbler, screener, defense changing its coverage, no shot at first.
etapes: (4 min) Screener opening up: short passes after the screen only, the screener leaves right away without staying stuck.
(6 min) Three dribbler decisions based on the read: if help comes, change direction or hit the open man; if the defender stays late, drive; if the defense drops back, pass.
(4 min) Reading help that changes, slides, drops, or shows: the offense answers with one matching pass idea.
(2 min) Flow: the sequence ends with a shot chosen from the options worked on, without slowing down to look for the perfect move.
x256.consignes: The pass has to arrive while the defender is choosing, not after.
x256.erreurs: Screener freezing after the screen, dribbler running through a frozen screen.
x256.corrections: Demand the screener leaves right away, remind them a good screen opens a read for the whole team.
x256.reussite: The dribbler picks an action without a second thought, the pass arrives inside the decision window.
x256.vEasy: One read at a time, passive defense.
x256.vHard: All three reads mixed with a defense changing its coverage.
x256.stats: Pick and roll efficiency, correct pick and roll reads

x257.titre: Gaps and the heart of the zone, breaking through before finishing
x257.objectif: Make a zone defense pay by creating a clear read, width then depth, before looking for the shot.
x257.placement: 5 on a zone defense, gaps must be created before every shot attempt.
etapes: (5 min) Attack width, then depth: the ball handler first looks for a side lane before threatening the middle.
(8 min) 5 against a zone, attacking the gaps: a gap has to open before the shot, otherwise reverse the ball or cut.
(5 min) Pass into the heart of the zone when the help is late, priority shot in the open area, otherwise the closest outside shot.
x257.consignes: When the zone closes the middle, the offense doesn't force it, it looks for the gap and the heart of the zone, then cuts behind if a hole opens.
x257.erreurs: Forced shot with no real gap, pass into the heart of the zone with no protection against the steal.
x257.corrections: Remind them of the golden rule, no shot without a visible gap, slow down the ball reversal if needed.

x258.titre: Protecting a lead, hunting the three, and handling the opponent's intentional fouls
x258.objectif: Combine three end-of-game modules depending on the goal: protect a lead, hunt a three-point shot, or handle the opponent's intentional fouls by getting the ball to the best free-throw shooter.
x258.placement: Offense at the end of a period with a called score margin, time left displayed.
etapes: (5 min) Lead module: the ball has to stay in play for a set number of seconds, tempo protection is the measure.

(2 min) Run the modules in game order: secure, then threaten, then close it out.
